package com.anonrode.downloader.providers

import com.anonrode.downloader.data.models.DownloadRecipe
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.models.ShowCard
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.models.ShowDetails
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.net.HttpClient
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.rules.DynamicRulesManager
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.DebugLog
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.channelFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull

object ProviderRegistry {

    private val staticProviders: List<SiteProvider> = listOf(
        NkiriProvider,
        DramaKeyProvider,
        AsianCProvider,
        AnitakuProvider,
        PlutoProvider,
        DramaRainProvider,
        RocksProvider,
        NaijaVaultProvider,
        NaijaPreyProvider,
        NepuProvider,
        TorrentProvider
    )

    val allProviders: List<SiteProvider>
        get() = staticProviders + DynamicRulesManager.getDynamicProviders()

    /**
     * Providers that may accept NEW work right now: the full registry minus
     * every site the signed payload's `contentPolicy.disabledSites` switch
     * holds OFF. Consumers: search fan-out, feed/site lists, failover.
     *
     * [getProvider] deliberately stays UNFILTERED: an already-running
     * download must still resolve its own episode after the operator disables
     * the site ("existing/running downloads may finish"). Only start-of-work
     * paths consult this list.
     */
    val enabledProviders: List<SiteProvider>
        get() = allProviders.filter { DynamicRulesManager.isSiteEnabled(it.name) }

    /** Names of the currently enabled providers (UI chip lists / diagnostics). */
    fun enabledProviderNames(): List<String> = enabledProviders.map { it.name }

    /** The OTA kill-switch verdict for one provider id (default true). */
    fun isSiteEnabled(site: String): Boolean = DynamicRulesManager.isSiteEnabled(site)

    /** Snapshot of (provider id -> enabled) for the current registry. */
    fun siteEnabledSnapshot(): Map<String, Boolean> =
        DynamicRulesManager.siteEnabledSnapshot(allProviders.map { it.name })

    /** Drops cards belonging to a disabled site. Exposed for the home/trending
     *  and category/Asian feed consumers, which fan out to site-specific
     *  fetchers rather than through [searchStreaming]. */
    fun filterEnabledCards(cards: List<ShowCard>): List<ShowCard> =
        cards.filter { DynamicRulesManager.isSiteEnabled(it.site) }

    fun getProvider(site: String): SiteProvider? {
        return allProviders.find { it.name.equals(site, ignoreCase = true) }
    }

    // ---- last-good search cache (RC-2) --------------------------------------
    //
    // The first search of a session paints late because every provider crawl
    // starts cold (asianc's first API call alone wedged 30s twice, share-43
    // §RC-2). This cache keeps the LAST GOOD non-empty result of every
    // (provider, normalized query) pair for 5 minutes: a repeat/cold query
    // paints instantly from memory while the normal fan-out refreshes in the
    // background.
    //
    // Rules that are load-bearing:
    //  - exact key: provider + EXACT normalized query. A cache hit can never
    //    surface a different query's cards (the old cross-query bleed bug).
    //  - never cache empty/failed: providers swallow failures into empty
    //    lists; an empty answer must never overwrite a good entry. (The
    //    drawer negative cache in loadEpisodes is a separate mechanism and is
    //    deliberately not duplicated here.)
    //  - bounded: hard LRU of [MAX_SEARCH_CACHE_ENTRIES]; no unbounded map.
    internal object SearchLastGoodCache {
        const val MAX_SEARCH_CACHE_ENTRIES = 64

        /** 5-minute freshness (owner spec). Internal setter = test seam. */
        internal var ttlMs: Long = 5 * 60_000L

        private data class Entry(val query: String, val atMs: Long, val cards: List<ShowCard>)

        private val lock = Any()
        private val lru = object : java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, Entry>(
            MAX_SEARCH_CACHE_ENTRIES, 0.75f, true
        ) {
            override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, Entry>?): Boolean {
                val evict = size > MAX_SEARCH_CACHE_ENTRIES
                if (evict) evictions.incrementAndGet()
                return evict
            }
        }
        private val hits = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong()
        private val misses = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong()
        private val stores = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong()
        private val evictions = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong()

        /** Case/whitespace-insensitive identity. Nothing else is normalized:
         *  two different queries must never share an entry. */
        fun normalizeQuery(raw: String): String = raw.trim().lowercase().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")

        private fun keyOf(provider: String, normalizedQuery: String): String =
            "${provider.trim().lowercase()}|$normalizedQuery"

        fun get(
            provider: String,
            normalizedQuery: String,
            nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
        ): List<ShowCard>? {
            val key = keyOf(provider, normalizedQuery)
            synchronized(lock) {
                val entry = lru[key]
                if (entry == null) {
                    misses.incrementAndGet()
                    return null
                }
                // Exact-query guard: even a key-shape collision must not
                // serve another query's cards.
                if (entry.query != normalizedQuery) {
                    lru.remove(key)
                    misses.incrementAndGet()
                    return null
                }
                if (nowMs - entry.atMs >= ttlMs) {
                    lru.remove(key)
                    misses.incrementAndGet()
                    return null
                }
                hits.incrementAndGet()
                return entry.cards
            }
        }

        /** Only a NON-EMPTY live answer is last-good. Returns true on store. */
        fun put(
            provider: String,
            normalizedQuery: String,
            cards: List<ShowCard>,
            nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
        ): Boolean {
            if (cards.isEmpty()) return false
            synchronized(lock) {
                lru[keyOf(provider, normalizedQuery)] = Entry(normalizedQuery, nowMs, cards.toList())
                stores.incrementAndGet()
            }
            return true
        }

        internal data class Stats(
            val hits: Long,
            val misses: Long,
            val stores: Long,
            val evictions: Long,
            val size: Int
        )

        internal fun stats(): Stats = synchronized(lock) {
            Stats(hits.get(), misses.get(), stores.get(), evictions.get(), lru.size)
        }

        internal fun clear() = synchronized(lock) {
            lru.clear()
            hits.set(0)
            misses.set(0)
            stores.set(0)
            evictions.set(0)
        }
    }

    /** Test seam: the provider fan-out used by [searchStreaming]. Production
     *  leaves this null (= [enabledProviders]). */
    internal var searchProvidersForTest: List<SiteProvider>? = null

    internal var searchCacheTtlMs: Long
        get() = SearchLastGoodCache.ttlMs
        set(value) { SearchLastGoodCache.ttlMs = value }

    internal fun clearSearchCachesForTest() {
        SearchLastGoodCache.clear()
        SearchLastGoodCache.ttlMs = 5 * 60_000L
    }

    internal fun searchCacheStatsForTest(): SearchLastGoodCache.Stats = SearchLastGoodCache.stats()

    // ---- search-result hygiene ----------------------------------------------
    //
    // Site search pages (nkiri's WordPress theme especially) embed sponsored
    // and ad cards: links to sbani.pro, cutt.ly shorteners and friends that
    // flow straight into the results grid as tappable cards. Two filters:
    //
    //  1. JUNK_HOSTS — a hard denylist, no exceptions. Shortener/ad hosts are
    //     never a legitimate search result.
    //  2. on-domain suffix rule — for the single-host providers, a card whose
    //     URL host is not the provider's own base domain (or any of its
    //     registered mirrors) is junk from the page's ad slots. Per-provider
    //     opt-in, kept conservative: anitaku legitimately returns results from
    //     TWO hosts (gogoanime.or.at AND anitaku.com.ro), naijaprey's episode
    //     drawer leaves its domain entirely (vdl.np-downloader.com,
    //     wildshare.net), and the OTA-dynamic providers' base URLs are
    //     data-driven — none of those get the rule.
    private val JUNK_HOSTS = listOf(
        "sbani.pro", "cutt.ly", "bit.ly", "tinyurl.com", "t.ly",
        "shorturl.at", "is.gd", "goo.gl", "rebrand.ly", "tiny.cc"
    )

    private val ON_DOMAIN_PROVIDERS = setOf("nkiri", "dramakey", "asianc", "pluto", "dramarain", "9jarocks", "naijavault", "nepu")

    private fun isJunkCard(provider: SiteProvider, card: ShowCard): Boolean {
        val url = card.url
        // magnet:/anything-not-http never hits site ad slots; leave it alone.
        if (!url.startsWith("http://", ignoreCase = true) && !url.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)) return false
        val host = HttpClient.safeHost(url)
        if (host.isBlank()) return false
        if (JUNK_HOSTS.any { host.equals(it, ignoreCase = true) || host.endsWith(".$it", ignoreCase = true) }) return true
        if (provider.name !in ON_DOMAIN_PROVIDERS) return false
        val allowedHosts = DynamicRulesManager.getBaseUrls(provider.name)
            .mapNotNull { base -> HttpClient.safeHost(base).takeIf { h -> h.isNotBlank() } }
        if (allowedHosts.isEmpty()) return false
        return allowedHosts.none { allowed -> host.equals(allowed, ignoreCase = true) || host.endsWith(".$allowed", ignoreCase = true) }
    }

    /** Filters one provider's raw results and journals every drop with its
     *  reason — a silently vanishing card was the old bug; the log must show
     *  WHY it vanished. */
    private fun filteredItems(provider: SiteProvider, items: List<ShowCard>): List<ShowCard> {
        return items.filter { card ->
            val junk = isJunkCard(provider, card)
            if (junk) {
                DebugLog.resolve("dropped junk search card provider=${provider.name} title=\"${card.title.take(60)}\" url=${card.url.take(80)}")
            }
            !junk
        }
    }

    fun searchStreaming(query: String, siteFilter: String? = null): Flow<List<ShowCard>> = channelFlow {
        val normalizedQuery = SearchLastGoodCache.normalizeQuery(query)
        val filterLabel = siteFilter?.trim()?.lowercase()?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "all"

        // Site-filter resolution must also honor the OTA kill switch: an
        // explicitly requested disabled site returns no cards, exactly like a
        // site with no results — no request is fired for it.
        val currentProviders = searchProvidersForTest ?: enabledProviders
        val targets = if (filterLabel != "all") {
            currentProviders.filter { it.name.equals(filterLabel, ignoreCase = true) || it.name.contains(filterLabel, ignoreCase = true) || filterLabel.contains(it.name, ignoreCase = true) }
        } else {
            currentProviders
        }.filter { it.searchEnabled && DynamicRulesManager.isSiteEnabled(it.name) }

        val timeoutMs = if (targets.size == 1) 15000L else 7000L

        // One basket per provider. A live refresh REPLACES that provider's
        // basket rather than appending, so a refreshed card can never sit
        // beside its stale cached twin.
        val baskets = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(LinkedHashMap<String, List<ShowCard>>())
        val emitMutex = Mutex()
        var liveResults = false

        fun snapshot(): List<ShowCard> {
            val all = synchronized(baskets) { baskets.values.toList().flatten() }
            return RelevanceScorer.filterAndSort(query, all)
        }

        // 1. INSTANT LAST-GOOD. Exact (provider, normalized query) entries
        // only — a different query never reads this entry. Enabled-site
        // filtering is re-applied because the OTA kill switch can flip
        // inside the TTL.
        for (provider in targets) {
            val cached = SearchLastGoodCache.get(provider.name, normalizedQuery) ?: continue
            // Re-filter: the OTA kill switch may have disabled a site since
            // this entry was stored. Never paint a basket that filters empty.
            val usable = filterEnabledCards(cached)
            if (usable.isNotEmpty()) baskets[provider.name] = usable
        }
        if (baskets.isNotEmpty()) {
            DebugLog.net(
                "search cache hit query=\"${normalizedQuery.take(60)}\" providers=${baskets.keys.joinToString(",")}"
            )
            send(snapshot())
        }

        // 2. BACKGROUND REFRESH. The crawl always runs — a fresh cache entry
        // must not freeze the results for its whole TTL. Empty/failed answers
        // never overwrite the last-good entry.
        coroutineScope {
            targets.forEach { provider ->
                launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    try {
                        val raw = withTimeoutOrNull(timeoutMs) { provider.search(query) } ?: emptyList()
                        val items = filterEnabledCards(filteredItems(provider, raw))
                        if (items.isNotEmpty()) {
                            SearchLastGoodCache.put(provider.name, normalizedQuery, items)
                            emitMutex.withLock {
                                baskets[provider.name] = items
                                liveResults = true
                                send(snapshot())
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                        throw cancelled
                    } catch (_: Exception) {}
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. END STATE. A failed refresh keeps the last-good paint on screen;
        // only a query with nothing cached AND nothing live emits the explicit
        // empty list that clears the previous query's grid.
        if (!liveResults && baskets.isEmpty()) {
            send(emptyList())
        }
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    // Search is deliberately INCLUDED in Nollywood suppression (unlike the
    // explicit filter's documented search bypass): a content-type block that
    // search can circumvent is only half-effective. Filtering happens at
    // EMISSION so the unfiltered list stays cached and a mid-TTL policy flip
    // still applies immediately on the next read.
    fun searchFlow(query: String, siteFilter: String? = null): Flow<List<ShowCard>> =
        searchStreaming(query, siteFilter)
            .map { com.anonrode.downloader.util.NollywoodFilter.filterSafe(it) }

    suspend fun loadEpisodes(show: ShowCard): ShowDetails {
        val provider = loadEpisodesProviderForTest ?: getProvider(show.site) ?: return ShowDetails(show = show)
        // OTA kill switch: a disabled site accepts no NEW work. Returning the
        // empty drawer (instead of throwing) is the same shape a site with no
        // episodes produces, so the UI shows its normal "no episodes" state.
        if (!DynamicRulesManager.isSiteEnabled(show.site)) {
            DebugLog.resolve("site disabled by OTA policy: refusing new episode load for ${show.site}")
            return ShowDetails(show = show)
        }
        // Drawer cache: the activity log showed the same ~130KiB show page being
        // re-fetched up to 5 times in one browsing session (every drawer open).
        // A 5-minute TTL per show kills that waste; the drawer's per-open job
        // still gets fresh data after the TTL or when the user pulls it again.
        val cacheKey = "${show.site}::${show.url}"
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        freshEpisodes(cacheKey, now)?.let { return it.details }
        // Single-flight (activity-log share-43, 10-20 00:19): concurrent
        // callers — drawer open + oracle verifier + prioritize re-wave — each
        // raced the TTL check and fetched the same dead page 8x in 7.7s.
        // One fetch per key; late arrivals re-check the cache the winner
        // just filled. The negative-result cache below makes an empty drawer
        // cacheable too: with only the positive branch cached, the SAME
        // page re-fetched on every wave because empties never stuck.
        val keyMutex = loadLocks.computeIfAbsent(cacheKey) { Mutex() }
        val details: ShowDetails = keyMutex.withLock {
            freshEpisodes(cacheKey, System.currentTimeMillis())?.let { return@withLock it.details }
            // Force IO here, not just at the call site: loadEpisodes does blocking
            // OkHttp, and a caller that forgets to switch off Main gets a
            // NetworkOnMainThreadException that HttpClient's blanket catch swallows
            // into an empty list ("No episodes found"). Guaranteeing it at the
            // source makes that whole failure class impossible regardless of caller.
            val fetched = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { provider.loadEpisodes(show.url) }
            val atMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
            episodesCache[cacheKey] = CacheEntry(atMs, fetched)
            return@withLock fetched
        }
        return details
    }

    /** Drawer-cache entry: positive results keep the historical 5-minute
     *  TTL; empty drawers get [emptyEpisodesTtlMs] so a 0-episode page
     *  (a-certain-dark-item-2026 class — site serves the post with an empty
     *  list) stops being re-fetched on every drawer open and verify wave
     *  while still healing itself within minutes when the site backfills.
     *  The TTL itself is read from the live policy in [freshEpisodes]. */
    private class CacheEntry(val atMs: Long, val details: ShowDetails)
    private val episodesCache = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, CacheEntry>()
    private val loadLocks = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Mutex>()
    internal var episodesTtlMs = 300_000L
    internal var emptyEpisodesTtlMs = 600_000L

    /** Cache hit only when present and inside the CURRENT ttl policy.
     *  The TTL is deliberately not snapshotted into the entry: an OTA/settings
     *  flip (or the test seam setting it to 0) must invalidate immediately,
     *  not after the previous window expires. */
    private fun freshEpisodes(cacheKey: String, now: Long): CacheEntry? {
        val entry = episodesCache[cacheKey] ?: return null
        val ttl = if (entry.details.episodes.isNotEmpty()) episodesTtlMs else emptyEpisodesTtlMs
        if (now - entry.atMs >= ttl) {
            episodesCache.remove(cacheKey, entry)
            return null
        }
        return entry
    }

    /** Seam over [getProvider] so [loadEpisodes]'s cache/single-flight is
     *  JVM-testable (static dispatch by site name). Production = null; tests
     *  inject a counting fake (ResultVerifier.chain pattern). */
    internal var loadEpisodesProviderForTest: SiteProvider? = null

    fun clearEpisodeCache() {
        episodesCache.clear()
        loadLocks.clear()
    }

    /** Resets all episode-cache state between tests
     *  (SubtitleSurfaces.clearForTest pattern). */
    internal fun clearEpisodeCachesForTest() {
        episodesCache.clear()
        loadLocks.clear()
    }

    suspend fun resolveEpisode(site: String, episodeUrl: String, quality: String): DownloadRecipe {
        val provider = getProvider(site) ?: return DownloadRecipe(
            directUrl = episodeUrl,
            filename = episodeUrl.substringAfterLast('/').substringBefore('?').ifEmpty { "media.mp4" },
            backend = "aria2c"
        )
        val recipe = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { provider.resolveEpisode(episodeUrl, quality) }
        // Carry the recipe's headers/subtitles across the String-only resolver
        // boundary (engine header propagation + subtitle sidecars).
        com.anonrode.downloader.pipeline.ResolvedHints.remember(episodeUrl, recipe)
        return recipe
    }
}

package com.anonrode.downloader.providers

import com.anonrode.downloader.data.models.ShowCard
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.net.HttpClient
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.rules.DynamicRulesManager
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.ExplicitContentFilter
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.NameSanitizer
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import org.jsoup.Jsoup

object AsianDramaFeed {

    private const val TIMEOUT_MS = 8000L
    private const val PER_SITE_LIMIT = 24
    private const val MAX_FEED_CARDS = 60

    fun cacheKeyFor(region: DramaRegion, era: DramaEra): String =
        "drama_${region.tag}_${era.tag}"

    suspend fun fetch(
        region: DramaRegion,
        era: DramaEra,
        page: Int = 1,
        forceRefresh: Boolean = false,
        filterExplicit: Boolean = true,
        onPartial: (List<ShowCard>) -> Unit = {}
    ): List<ShowCard> {
        val key = cacheKeyFor(region, era)

        // 1. Return fresh cached cards immediately if available on page 1
        if (page == 1 && !forceRefresh && FeedCache.isCategoryFresh(key)) {
            val cached = FeedCache.categoryCards(key)
            if (cached.isNotEmpty()) {
                val filtered = com.anonrode.downloader.util.NollywoodFilter.filterSafe(
                    if (filterExplicit) ExplicitContentFilter.filterSafe(cached) else cached
                )
                onPartial(filtered)
                return filtered
            }
        }

        // 2. Fetch live across candidate providers concurrently
        return coroutineScope {
            // OTA kill-switch: disabled sites never join the drama fan-out.
            val candidateSites = SiteGate.filterEnabled(
                when (region) {
                    DramaRegion.KDRAMA -> listOf("dramakey", "asianc", "dramarain", "nepu", "nkiri", "9jarocks")
                    DramaRegion.CDRAMA -> listOf("dramarain", "dramakey", "asianc", "nepu", "nkiri", "9jarocks")
                }
            )

            val slots = arrayOfNulls<List<ShowCard>>(candidateSites.size)
            val lock = Any()

            candidateSites.mapIndexed { i, site ->
                async(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val cards = withTimeoutOrNull(TIMEOUT_MS) {
                        fetchSiteFor(site, region, era, page, filterExplicit)
                    } ?: emptyList()

                    synchronized(lock) {
                        slots[i] = cards
                        val availablePairs = candidateSites.mapIndexed { j, s -> s to (slots[j] ?: emptyList()) }
                        val currentMix = CategoryFeed.mixCards(availablePairs, filterExplicit)
                        if (currentMix.isNotEmpty()) {
                            onPartial(currentMix)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }.awaitAll()

            val finalPairs = candidateSites.mapIndexed { j, s -> s to (slots[j] ?: emptyList()) }
            val finalMixed = CategoryFeed.mixCards(finalPairs, filterExplicit)
            val result = finalMixed

            if (page == 1 && result.isNotEmpty()) {
                FeedCache.saveCategory(key, result)
            }
            result
        }
    }

    private suspend fun fetchSiteFor(
        site: String,
        region: DramaRegion,
        era: DramaEra,
        page: Int,
        filterExplicit: Boolean
    ): List<ShowCard> {
        if (!SiteGate.isEnabled(site)) return emptyList()
        return try {
            when (site) {
                "asianc" -> fetchAsianC(region, era, page, filterExplicit)
                "dramakey" -> fetchDramaKey(region, era, page, filterExplicit)
                "dramarain" -> fetchDramaRain(region, era, page, filterExplicit)
                "nepu" -> if (page > 1) emptyList() else fetchNepu(region, era, filterExplicit)
                "nkiri" -> fetchNkiri(region, era, page, filterExplicit)
                "9jarocks" -> fetch9jaRocks(region, era, page, filterExplicit)
                else -> emptyList()
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    private suspend fun fetchAsianC(
        region: DramaRegion,
        era: DramaEra,
        page: Int,
        filterExplicit: Boolean
    ): List<ShowCard> {
        val base = DynamicRulesManager.getBaseUrl("asianc").ifBlank { "https://asianc.id" }.trimEnd('/')
        val pageSuffix = if (page > 1) "&page=$page" else ""
        val url = when {
            region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA && era == DramaEra.HISTORICAL -> "$base/search?type=drama&keyword=historical$pageSuffix"
            region == DramaRegion.CDRAMA && era == DramaEra.HISTORICAL -> "$base/search?type=drama&keyword=wuxia$pageSuffix"
            region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA -> "$base/search?type=drama&keyword=korean$pageSuffix"
            else -> "$base/search?type=drama&keyword=chinese$pageSuffix"
        }

        val html = HttpClient.getText(url, referer = "$base/", tag = "browse") ?: return emptyList()
        val doc = Jsoup.parse(html, url)
        val cards = mutableListOf<ShowCard>()

        for (item in doc.select("ul.listing.items li, .list-episode-item li, .video-block, li.filter-item")) {
            val a = item.selectFirst("a[href*='/drama-detail/']") ?: item.selectFirst("a[href]") ?: continue
            val rawHref = a.attr("href")
            if (rawHref.isBlank()) continue
            val fullUrl = if (rawHref.startsWith("/")) "$base$rawHref" else rawHref

            val titleEl = item.selectFirst(".title, h3, .name") ?: a
            val rawTitle = titleEl.text().trim()
            if (rawTitle.isBlank()) continue

            val img = item.selectFirst("img")
            val poster = img?.attr("abs:data-original")?.ifBlank {
                img.attr("data-original").ifBlank {
                    img.attr("abs:src").ifBlank { img.attr("src") }
                }
            }.orEmpty()

            val clean = NameSanitizer.cleanTitle(rawTitle)
            val card = ShowCard(
                title = clean.ifBlank { rawTitle },
                url = fullUrl,
                posterUrl = poster,
                site = "asianc",
                category = if (region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA) "K-Drama" else "C-Drama",
                tags = listOf(region.label, era.label),
                genres = listOf(region.label, era.label)
            )

            if (!filterExplicit || !ExplicitContentFilter.isExplicit(card)) {
                cards.add(card)
            }
            if (cards.size >= PER_SITE_LIMIT) break
        }
        return cards
    }

    private suspend fun fetchDramaKey(

        val html = HttpClient.getText(url, referer = "$base/", tag = "browse") ?: return emptyList()
        val doc = Jsoup.parse(html, url)

        for (item in doc.select("a.series-card-link, .series-item, .drama-card, article.series-card, article, .item")) {
            val a = (if (item.tagName() == "a") item else item.selectFirst("a.series-card-link") ?: item.selectFirst("a"))
                ?: item.parent()?.takeIf { it.tagName() == "a" } ?: continue
            val href = a.attr("abs:href").ifBlank {
                val raw = a.attr("href")
                if (raw.startsWith("/")) "$base$raw" else raw
            }
            if (href.isBlank()) continue

            val titleEl = item.selectFirst(".series-title, .title, h2, h3, .entry-title") ?: a
            val rawTitle = titleEl.text().trim().ifBlank { a.attr("aria-label").removePrefix("View ").trim() }
            if (rawTitle.isBlank() || rawTitle.length < 2) continue

            val img = item.selectFirst("img") ?: a.selectFirst("img")
            val poster = img?.attr("abs:src")?.ifBlank { img.attr("src") }.orEmpty()

            val clean = NameSanitizer.cleanTitle(rawTitle)

                url = href,
                posterUrl = poster,
                site = "dramakey",
                category = if (region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA) "K-Drama" else "C-Drama",
                tags = listOf(region.label, era.label),
                genres = listOf(region.label, era.label)
            )

            if (!filterExplicit || !ExplicitContentFilter.isExplicit(card)) {
                cards.add(card)
            }
            if (cards.size >= PER_SITE_LIMIT) break
        }
        return cards
    }

    private suspend fun fetchDramaRain(

            if (rawTitle.isBlank()) continue

            val img = item.selectFirst("img")
            val poster = img?.attr("abs:src")?.ifBlank { img.attr("src") }.orEmpty()

            val clean = NameSanitizer.cleanTitle(rawTitle)
            val dramaTags = listOf(region.label, era.label, if (rawTitle.contains("(Complete)")) "Completed" else "Ongoing")
            val card = ShowCard(
                title = clean.ifBlank { rawTitle },
                url = href,
                posterUrl = poster,
                site = "dramarain",
                category = if (region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA) "K-Drama" else "C-Drama",
                tags = dramaTags,
                genres = dramaTags
            )

            if (!filterExplicit || !ExplicitContentFilter.isExplicit(card)) {
                cards.add(card)
            }
            if (cards.size >= PER_SITE_LIMIT) break
        }
        return cards
    }

    private suspend fun fetchNepu(
        region: DramaRegion,
        era: DramaEra,
        filterExplicit: Boolean
    ): List<ShowCard> {
        val query = when {
            era == DramaEra.HISTORICAL && region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA -> "sageuk"
            era == DramaEra.HISTORICAL -> "wuxia"
            region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA -> "korean drama"
            else -> "chinese drama"
        }
        val raw = TrendingFeed.fetchApiSearch("nepu", query, PER_SITE_LIMIT)
        return if (filterExplicit) ExplicitContentFilter.filterSafe(raw) else raw
    }

    private suspend fun fetchNkiri(
        region: DramaRegion,
        era: DramaEra,
        page: Int,
        filterExplicit: Boolean
    ): List<ShowCard> {
        val query = when {
            era == DramaEra.HISTORICAL && region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA -> "sageuk"
            era == DramaEra.HISTORICAL -> "wuxia"
            region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA -> "korean drama"
            else -> "chinese drama"
        }
        return TrendingFeed.fetchWpRest("nkiri", query = query, page = page, limit = PER_SITE_LIMIT, filterExplicit = filterExplicit)
    }

    private suspend fun fetch9jaRocks(
        region: DramaRegion,
        era: DramaEra,
        page: Int,
        filterExplicit: Boolean
    ): List<ShowCard> {
        val term = if (region == DramaRegion.KDRAMA) "korean drama" else "chinese drama"
        val enc = java.net.URLEncoder.encode(term, "UTF-8")
        val path = if (page > 1) "/search/$enc/feed/rss2/?paged=$page" else "/search/$enc/feed/rss2/"
        return TrendingFeed.fetchRss("9jarocks", path, filterExplicit = filterExplicit)
    }
}

import java.util.regex.Pattern

data class CleanedQuery(
    val coreTitle: String,
    val targetSeason: Int? = null,
    val targetPart: Int? = null
)

object SeasonNoiseStripper {
    fun clean(query: String): CleanedQuery {
        var core = query.trim()
        var season: Int? = null
        var part: Int? = null

        // 1. Extract season (e.g. s05, s5, season 5, 2nd season, 7th season)
        Regex("""(?i)\b(?:season|s)\s*(\d{1,2})\b""").find(core)?.let {
            season = it.groupValues[1].toIntOrNull()
        } ?: Regex("""(?i)\b(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+season\b""").find(core)?.let {
            season = it.groupValues[1].toIntOrNull()
        }

        // 2. Extract part/cour (e.g. part 2, cour 1)
        Regex("""(?i)\b(?:part|cour)\s*(\d{1,2})\b""").find(core)?.let {
            part = it.groupValues[1].toIntOrNull()
        }

        // 3. Strip season/part/series noise
        core = core.replace(Regex("""(?i)\b(?:season|s)\s*\d{1,2}\b"""), " ")
            .replace(Regex("""(?i)\b\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+season\b"""), " ")
            .replace(Regex("""(?i)\b(?:part|cour)\s*\d{1,2}\b"""), " ")
            .replace(Regex("""(?i)\bseries\b"""), " ")
            .replace(Regex("""\s+"""), " ")
            .trim()

        val finalCore = if (core.length >= 2) core else query.trim()
        return CleanedQuery(finalCore, season, part)
    }
}

object AnitakuProvider : SiteProvider {
    override val name: String = "anitaku"
    override val mainUrl: String get() = DynamicRulesManager.getBaseUrl(name)

    private fun formatDisplayTitle(title: String, coreQuery: String): String {
        val qTokens = RelevanceScorer.tokenize(coreQuery)
        val tTokens = RelevanceScorer.tokenize(title)
        if (qTokens.isNotEmpty() && qTokens.intersect(tTokens).isEmpty()) {
            val prettyCore = coreQuery.split(" ")
                .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
                .joinToString(" ") { it.replaceFirstChar { c -> c.uppercase() } }
            return "$title ($prettyCore)"
        }
        return title
    }

    private fun postProcessResults(items: List<ShowCard>, cleaned: CleanedQuery): List<ShowCard> {
        val deduplicated = items.distinctBy { it.url.trimEnd('/') }
        if (cleaned.targetSeason == null) return deduplicated

        val sNum = cleaned.targetSeason
        return deduplicated.sortedByDescending { card ->
            val tLower = card.title.lowercase()
            when {
                tLower.contains("season $sNum") || tLower.contains("season 0$sNum") -> 3
                tLower.contains("s$sNum") || tLower.contains("s0$sNum") -> 2
                tLower.contains("${sNum}st season") || tLower.contains("${sNum}nd season") ||
                    tLower.contains("${sNum}rd season") || tLower.contains("${sNum}th season") -> 3
                else -> 0
            }
        }
    }

    internal fun parseAjaxCards(body: String, cleaned: CleanedQuery): List<ShowCard> {

        try {
            val json = JSONObject(body)
            val keys = json.keys()
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                val key = keys.next()

                for (i in 0 until group.length()) {

                    val all = block.optJSONArray("all") ?: continue
                    for (j in 0 until all.length()) {

                        val rawTitle = item.optString("post_title").trim()
                        val image = item.optString("post_image")
                        val sub = item.optString("post_sub")

                        if (link.isNotBlank() && rawTitle.isNotBlank()) {
                            val displayTitle = formatDisplayTitle(rawTitle, cleaned.coreTitle)
                            batch.add(
                                ShowCard(

                                    url = link,

                                    site = name,
                                    category = "Anime ${if (sub.isNotBlank()) "($sub)" else ""}"

        } catch (_: Exception) {}

    override suspend fun search(query: String): List<ShowCard> {

    private suspend fun searchLive(cleaned: CleanedQuery, rawQuery: String): List<ShowCard> {

        val searchTerms = (if (expandedTerms.isNotEmpty()) expandedTerms else listOf(primaryTerm))
            .map { it.trim() }

    /** Backfills a pipeline card's blank poster from the compiled AJAX search. */
    private suspend fun backfillAnimePosters(term: String, cards: List<ShowCard>): List<ShowCard> {

        if (clean.none { it.posterUrl.isBlank() }) return clean
        val cleaned = SeasonNoiseStripper.clean(term)

            if (compiled.isEmpty()) continue
            for (card in compiled) {
                if (card.posterUrl.isNotBlank()) {

                }
            }
            break
        }
        return PosterBackfill.backfill(clean) { posters }

    private fun cachedSearch(key: String): List<ShowCard>? = synchronized(searchCacheLock) {
        val hit = searchCache[key] ?: return null
        if (hit.expiresAtMs < System.currentTimeMillis()) {
            searchCache.remove(key)
            return null
        }
        hit.cards
    }

    private fun rememberSearch(key: String, cards: List<ShowCard>) {
        if (key.isBlank() || cards.isEmpty()) return
        synchronized(searchCacheLock) {
            searchCache[key] = CachedSearch(cards, System.currentTimeMillis() + SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_MS)
        }
    }

    internal fun clearSearchCacheForTest() {
        synchronized(searchCacheLock) { searchCache.clear() }
    }

    private data class CachedSearch(val cards: List<ShowCard>, val expiresAtMs: Long)
    private const val SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000L
    private val searchCacheLock = Any()
    private val searchCache = object : java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, CachedSearch>(64, 0.75f, true) {

            size > 64
    }

    override suspend fun loadEpisodes(showUrl: String): ShowDetails {
        if (!SiteGate.isEnabled(name)) {
            return ShowDetails(show = ShowCard(title = "Anime", url = showUrl, site = name))
        }
        val show = ShowCard(title = "Anime", url = showUrl, site = name)

        DynamicRulesManager.getPipeline(name)?.episodes?.let { pl ->
            val res = RulesPipeline.runEpisodes(name, pl, showUrl)
            if (res != null && res.episodes.isNotEmpty()) {
                val card = ShowCard(
                    title = res.metaTitle ?: "Anime",
                    url = showUrl,
                    posterUrl = if (PosterBackfill.isUsablePoster(res.metaPoster.orEmpty())) res.metaPoster.orEmpty() else "",
                    site = name
                )
                return ShowDetails(show = card, synopsis = res.metaSynopsis ?: "", episodes = res.episodes)
            }
        }

        try {
            val html = HttpClient.getText(showUrl) ?: return ShowDetails(show = show)
            val doc = Jsoup.parse(html, showUrl)

            val title = doc.selectFirst(".anime_info_body_bg h1, h1.entry-title, h1")?.text()?.trim() ?: "Anime"
            val poster = doc.selectFirst(".anime_info_body_bg img, .thumb img, meta[property='og:image']")?.let {
                if (it.tagName() == "meta") it.attr("content") else it.attr("abs:src").ifBlank { it.attr("src") }
            } ?: ""
            val synopsis = doc.selectFirst(".description, .entry-content p")?.text()?.trim() ?: ""

            val episodes = mutableListOf<EpisodeItem>()
            val seen = mutableSetOf<String>()
            PostContentSanitizer.clean(doc)
            // Live 2026-10-20 (gogoanime.or.at): the list is
            // `.eplister ul li a > .epl-num` + `.epl-title`; the old selector
            // set already matched .eplister but read the number from raw
            // anchor text (which also carries the show title and "1" from
            // "Season 1" — the .epl-num cell is the exact episode).
            val epLinks = doc.select(
                ".eplister ul li a, .bixbox.bxcl.epcheck a, .episodes a, ul.episodes-lists li a, " +
                    "#episode_page a, a[href*='-episode-'], a[href*='-movie-'], a[href*='episode']"
            )

            for (a in epLinks) {
                val rawHref = a.attr("href").trim()
                if (rawHref.isBlank() || rawHref == "#" || rawHref.startsWith("#") || rawHref.startsWith("javascript:")) continue

                val href = a.attr("abs:href").ifBlank {
                    HttpClient.safeResolveUri(showUrl, rawHref)
                }.substringBefore('#')

                if (href.isBlank() || href == showUrl || href in seen || href.contains("/category/") || href.contains("/genre/")) continue
                if (showUrl.contains("/anime/") && href.endsWith("/anime/")) continue
                val nameText = a.selectFirst(".epl-title")?.text()?.trim().orEmpty().ifBlank { a.text().trim() }
                if (PostContentSanitizer.isSiblingPostAnchorText(nameText)) continue
                seen.add(href)
                val num = a.selectFirst(".epl-num")?.text()?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
                    ?: Regex("""\d+""").find(nameText)?.value?.toIntOrNull()
                    ?: Regex("""episode-(\d+)""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).find(href)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                    ?: (episodes.size + 1)

                episodes.add(
                    EpisodeItem(
                        title = if (nameText.isNotBlank() && !nameText.equals("#", ignoreCase = true)) nameText else "Episode $num",
                        url = href,
                        episodeNum = com.anonrode.downloader.util.SeasonEpisode.encode(1, num),
                        site = name,
                        season = 1,
                        episode = num
                    )
                )
            }

            // Single-episode / Movie fallback if epLinks were empty or pointed to the show page itself
            if (episodes.isEmpty()) {
                val playerIframe = doc.selectFirst("iframe[src], .anime_muti_link a[data-video], .servers a[data-video]")
                if (playerIframe != null) {
                    episodes.add(
                        EpisodeItem(
                            title = "Movie / Episode 1",
                            url = showUrl,
                            episodeNum = com.anonrode.downloader.util.SeasonEpisode.encode(1, 1),
                            site = name,
                            season = 1,
                            episode = 1
                        )
                    )
                }
            }

            // Subtitle surfaces on the show/episode page (srt/vtt/ass links or
            // <track> elements) — recorded for the engine's sidecar step.
            val subtitleTracks = SubtitleSurfaces.parsePageTracks(doc, showUrl)
            if (subtitleTracks.isNotEmpty()) SubtitleSurfaces.record(showUrl, subtitleTracks)

            val card = ShowCard(
                title = title,
                url = showUrl,
                posterUrl = if (PosterBackfill.isUsablePoster(poster)) poster else "",
                site = name
            )
            return ShowDetails(show = card, synopsis = synopsis, episodes = episodes.sortedBy { it.episodeNum })
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            return ShowDetails(show = show)
        }
    }

    override suspend fun resolveEpisode(episodeUrl: String, quality: String): DownloadRecipe {
        val shadowControlStart = System.currentTimeMillis()
        // OTA resolve recipe first: when a signed playbook carries the
        // resolve+terminal stages it replaces this compiled scraping flow
        // entirely — and skips the page fetch below on success. The compiled
        // path stays the untouched fallback (playbook absent, or resolve fails).
        val ota = RulesPipeline.runResolveForSite(name, episodeUrl, quality)
        var direct: String? = ota

        if (direct == null) {
            try {
                val html = HttpClient.getText(episodeUrl, referer = "https://gogoanime.or.at/") ?: ""

                // 1. Direct candidate player embeds on page (newplayer.php, megaplay.buzz, megaplays.se, takuembed, mirror dropdowns)
                val doc = Jsoup.parse(html, episodeUrl)
                val subtitleTracks = SubtitleSurfaces.parsePageTracks(doc, episodeUrl)
                if (subtitleTracks.isNotEmpty()) SubtitleSurfaces.record(episodeUrl, subtitleTracks)
                val candidates = mutableListOf<String>()

                // Dynamic OTA mirror selectors allow updating mirror/server DOM selectors in future OTA updates
                val otaSelectors = DynamicRulesManager.getMirrorSelectors(name) +
                    DynamicRulesManager.getMirrorSelectors("gogoanime") +
                    DynamicRulesManager.getMirrorSelectors("anitaku")
                val baseSelectors = listOf(
                    "select.mirror option[value]",
                    "select#mirror-select option[value]",
                    "select[name='mirror'] option[value]",
                    ".anime_muti_link a[data-video]",
                    ".servers a[data-video]",
                    ".anime_muti_link a[href]",
                    "iframe[src]"
                )
                val allSelectors = (otaSelectors + baseSelectors).distinct()

                for (selector in allSelectors) {
                    for (el in doc.select(selector)) {
                        val valueAttr = el.attr("value").trim()
                        if (valueAttr.isNotBlank()) {
                            // Check if value is base64-encoded iframe or URL
                            val decoded = if (valueAttr.length >= 16 && (valueAttr.startsWith("PGlm") || valueAttr.startsWith("aHR0") || !valueAttr.contains(" "))) {
                                try {
                                    String(android.util.Base64.decode(valueAttr, android.util.Base64.DEFAULT), Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
                                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                                    try {
                                        String(java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(valueAttr), Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
                                    } catch (_: Throwable) { "" }
                                }
                            } else ""

                            if (decoded.isNotBlank()) {
                                val m = Pattern.compile("""src=["']([^"']+)["']""", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE).matcher(decoded)
                                if (m.find()) {
                                    val src = m.group(1)?.trim().orEmpty()
                                    if (src.isNotBlank() && !src.startsWith("javascript:")) candidates.add(src)
                                } else if (decoded.startsWith("http://") || decoded.startsWith("https://")) {
                                    candidates.add(decoded)
                                }
                            } else if (valueAttr.startsWith("http://") || valueAttr.startsWith("https://")) {
                                candidates.add(valueAttr)
                            }
                        }

                        val dataVideo = el.attr("data-video").trim()
                        if (dataVideo.isNotBlank() && !dataVideo.startsWith("javascript:")) {
                            candidates.add(dataVideo)
                        }

                        val src = el.attr("src").trim()
                        if (src.isNotBlank() && !src.startsWith("javascript:")) {
                            candidates.add(src)
                        }

                        val href = el.attr("href").trim()
                        if (href.isNotBlank() && !href.startsWith("javascript:") && !href.startsWith("#")) {
                            candidates.add(href)
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (candidates.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val fullCandidates = candidates.distinct().map { HttpClient.safeResolveUri(episodeUrl, it) }
                    // Provider-issued fan-out; bypass stale HostHealth pre-judges.
                    val resolved = ResolverRegistry.resolveAny(fullCandidates, quality, bypassHealth = true)
                    if (!resolved.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        direct = resolved
                    }
                }

                // 2. Gogoanime fetch_download_links API fallback
                if (direct.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    val malMatch = Pattern.compile("""malId\s*=\s*['"](\d+)['"]""").matcher(html)
                    val epMatch = Pattern.compile("""ep\s*=\s*['"](\d+)['"]""").matcher(html)
                    if (malMatch.find() && epMatch.find()) {
                        val malId = malMatch.group(1) ?: ""
                        val ep = epMatch.group(1) ?: ""
                        // N2-fix (investigation anime100): some gogo-hosted
                        // episodes expose ONLY a transport-dead player lane, but
                        // the page still carries malId/ep — the megaplays mal
                        // endpoint is the live lane (mal 59433/5 proven to
                        // MPEG-TS on the wire). The fetchdl ajax below stays as
                        // the follow-up fallback (its gap is site-side data).
                        ResolverRegistry.resolveAny(
                            listOf("https://megaplays.se/stream/mal/$malId/$ep/sub"),
                            quality,
                            bypassHealth = true
                        )?.let { direct = it }
                        val host = HttpClient.safeHost(episodeUrl, "gogoanime.or.at")
                        val ajaxUrl = "https://$host/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php"

                        val form = mapOf(
                            "action" to "fetch_download_links",
                            "mal_id" to malId,
                            "ep" to ep
                        )
                        // Ajax runs only if the megaplays handoff above missed.
                        val body = if (direct.isNullOrBlank()) HttpClient.postForm(
                            url = ajaxUrl,
                            form = form,
                            referer = episodeUrl,
                            headers = mapOf("X-Requested-With" to "XMLHttpRequest")
                        ) else null
                        if (!body.isNullOrBlank()) {
                            val dlHtml = JSONObject(body).optJSONObject("data")?.optString("result") ?: ""
                            if (dlHtml.isNotBlank()) {
                                val dlDoc = Jsoup.parse(dlHtml, episodeUrl)
                                val dlList = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, String>>()
                                for (a in dlDoc.select("a[href]")) {
                                    val label = a.text().trim().lowercase()
                                    val hVal = Regex("""(\d+)p?""").find(label)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 720
                                    val link = a.attr("abs:href").ifBlank { a.attr("href") }
                                    if (link.isNotBlank()) dlList.add(hVal to link)
                                }
                                val reqHeight = quality.filter { it.isDigit() }.toIntOrNull() ?: 720
                                val sortedLinks = if (dlList.isNotEmpty()) {
                                    dlList.sortedWith(compareBy({ (h, _) -> if (h <= reqHeight) 0 else 1 }, { (h, _) -> Math.abs(h - reqHeight) }))
                                        .map { it.second }
                                } else {
                                    dlDoc.select("a[href]").map { it.attr("abs:href").ifBlank { it.attr("href") } }
                                }
                                val resolved = ResolverRegistry.resolveAny(sortedLinks, quality, bypassHealth = true)
                                if (!resolved.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                    direct = resolved
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }

        val target = if (!direct.isNullOrBlank()) direct else {
            if (com.anonrode.downloader.pipeline.StrictLinkClassifier.isDirectMedia(episodeUrl)) episodeUrl else ""
        }
        val isHls = target.contains(".m3u8") || target.contains("manifest")
        // Scientist control seam: this compiled path IS the user-facing
        // control whenever the pipelines family runs shadow-armed (published
        // empty). Report only the outcome class — never URLs — so ShadowRunner
        // issues real both-engine comparison records.
        com.anonrode.downloader.pipeline.ShadowRunner.observeControl(
            name,
            success = target.isNotBlank(),
            wallMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - shadowControlStart
        )
        return DownloadRecipe(
            directUrl = target,
            filename = target.substringAfterLast('/').substringBefore('?').ifEmpty { "anime.mp4" },
            backend = if (isHls) "yt-dlp" else "aria2c",
            parallelSockets = 16
        )
    }
}

private fun drawerEpLabel(season: Int, episode: Int): String =
    if (season > 0 || episode > 0) "S%02dE%02d".format(season, episode) else "Ep $episode"

/**
 * Shared "remaining" semantics for the episode drawer and the Downloads
 * series card.
 *
 * PAUSED is NOT in flight. It is remaining work that the user can resume,
 * and re-enqueueing that source URL resumes the existing task (see
 * DownloadEngine.enqueue's resumableExisting branch) rather than creating a
 * duplicate. FAILED is also remaining. Only COMPLETED and the four active /
 * queued statuses count as done-or-in-flight.
 */
internal fun isInFlightStatus(status: TaskStatus): Boolean = when (status) {
    TaskStatus.QUEUED,
    TaskStatus.RESOLVING,
    TaskStatus.DOWNLOADING,
    TaskStatus.VALIDATING -> true
    else -> false
}

internal fun remainingEpisodesOf(
    episodes: List<EpisodeItem>,
    completedUrls: Set<String>,
    inFlightUrls: Set<String>,
    /** Watched episodes are excluded even when their file was deleted
     *  (directive §4: Remaining must never re-download something you watched). */
    watchedUrls: Set<String> = emptySet()
): List<EpisodeItem> = episodes.filter {
    it.url !in completedUrls && it.url !in inFlightUrls && it.url !in watchedUrls
}

/** Downloads-card hint: seriesTotal minus completed/in-flight tasks.
 *  PAUSED and FAILED therefore keep the "Download remaining N" action
 *  visible instead of silently decrementing it to zero. */
internal fun seriesRemainingCount(seriesTotal: Int, statuses: List<TaskStatus>): Int {
    val doneOrInFlight = statuses.count {
        it == TaskStatus.COMPLETED || isInFlightStatus(it)
    }
    return (seriesTotal - doneOrInFlight).coerceAtLeast(0)
}

                val end = p.substringAfter('-').trim().toIntOrNull()

    // it. Fallbacks: an SxxEyy title token, a "season-N" page/URL token, the
    // NEPU-style season path, then the legacy episodeNum convention. The old
    // unconditional `episodeNum / 100` is what moved 9jaRocks S01E101+ (and
    // flat per-season 1..N pages) into a fictional Season 2.
    val seasonGroups = remember(episodes) {
        val groups = mutableMapOf<Int, MutableList<EpisodeItem>>()
        for (ep in episodes) {
            val titleToken = Regex("S([0-9]{1,2})(?:E([0-9]{1,3}))?", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
                .find(ep.title)?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
            val sNum = ep.season.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: titleToken
                ?: Regex("season[\\s._-]*(\\d{1,2})", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
                    .find("${ep.title} ${ep.url}")?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                ?: Regex("/watch/(?:tv|movie)/\\d+/(\\d+)(?:/|$)", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
                    .find(ep.url)?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                ?: SeasonEpisode.seasonOf(ep)
            groups.getOrPut(sNum) { mutableListOf() }.add(ep)
        }
        groups.toSortedMap().mapValues { (_, values) ->
            values.sortedWith(compareBy({ SeasonEpisode.episodeOf(it) }, { it.title }))
        }
    }
    var expandedSeasons by remember(show.url, seasonGroups.keys) {
        mutableStateOf(seasonGroups.keys)
    }
    val uniqueSelectedCount = selectedEpisodes.distinctBy { it.url }.size

    fun enqueueSelected(forceAll: Boolean = false) {
        if (enqueued || isEnqueuing) return
        // §2.7 zero-selection CTA: the Download button is rendered as
        // "Download All (N)" when nothing is picked, and it MEANS it —
        // forceAll enqueues every listed episode in the same batch order.
        // Combined provider pages may intentionally reuse one anchor URL for
        // multiple episodes. Keep every selected row visible, but never enqueue
        // that source more than once in the same batch.
        val picked = if (forceAll) episodes else selectedEpisodes
        val toEnqueue = picked
            .distinctBy { it.url }
            .sortedWith(compareBy(
                { episode -> seasonGroups.entries.firstOrNull { it.value.any { it === episode } }?.key ?: Int.MAX_VALUE },
                { SeasonEpisode.episodeOf(it) },
                { it.title }
            ))
        if (toEnqueue.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Select at least one episode first", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        isEnqueuing = true
        enqueued = true
        hapticView.confirmHaptic()
        viewModel.viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                val cleanFolder = com.anonrode.downloader.util.NameSanitizer.cleanShowFolder(show.title)
                // AUDIT FIX (2026-10-19, cross-doc audit BUG 7): enqueue in
                // REVERSE order with queue processing deferred to the final
                // call. repository.addFirst prepends, so the LAST enqueued
                // task lands at index 0: ascending enqueue put E8 at the top
                // of the queue list, and once the initial wave saturated the
                // concurrency slots every later slot-free picked
                // firstOrNull{QUEUED} = E8, E7, … — the tail of any batch
                // larger than the concurrency limit downloaded IN REVERSE.
                // Reversed + a single final trigger: E1 sits at index 0 and
                // starts first; engine semantics and QueueOrderTest untouched.
                toEnqueue.asReversed().forEachIndexed { i, ep ->
                    val isFinalEnqueue = i == toEnqueue.lastIndex
                    viewModel.engine.enqueue(
                        showTitle = cleanFolder,
                        episodeNum = ep.episodeNum,
                        season = ep.season,
                        episode = ep.episode,
                        episodeTitle = com.anonrode.downloader.util.NameSanitizer.formatEpisodeTitle(
                            showTitle = show.title,
                            episodeNum = ep.episodeNum,
                            rawEpisodeLabel = ep.title,
                            season = ep.season,
                            episode = ep.episode,
                            site = ep.site.ifBlank { show.site }
                        ),
                        sourceUrl = ep.url,
                        mirrorUrls = ep.mirrorUrls,
                        isDirect = false,
                        backend = "aria2c",
                        site = ep.site.ifBlank { show.site },
                        parallelSockets = viewModel.engine.parallelSocketsPerFile,
                        verifiedDirectUrl = com.anonrode.downloader.pipeline.ResultVerifier.verifiedDirect(ep.url),
                        seriesUrl = show.url,
                        seriesTotal = maxOf(episodes.size, show.totalEpisodes),
                        posterUrl = show.posterUrl,
                        triggerQueueProcessing = isFinalEnqueue
                    )
                }
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { onDismiss() }
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    isEnqueuing = false
                    enqueued = false
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Could not queue downloads. Try again.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ═════════════════════════ HALF-SHEET CHASSIS (detents + gestures) ═════════════════════════
    Dialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        properties = DialogProperties(
            usePlatformDefaultWidth = false,
            // Full-bleed: the sheet content extends under the status bar at FULL.
            decorFitsSystemWindows = false
        )
    ) {
        // The sheet follows the app theme (DarkSheetPalette / LightSheetPalette),
        // so the dialog window's status-bar icons must follow it too — white
        // icons over the dark sheet, DARK icons over the light sheet. Forcing
        // light icons unconditionally painted an invisible clock over the
        // light sheet at the FULL detent. The app window's own flag re-applies
        // untouched the moment the dialog dismisses.
        val dialogWindow = (LocalView.current.parent as? DialogWindowProvider)?.window
        // Read the sheet's dark state HERE: AnonTheme.colors is a @Composable
        // getter, so it cannot be read from the non-composable SideEffect below.
        val sheetIsDark = AnonTheme.colors.isDark
        SideEffect {
            dialogWindow?.let { w ->
                // WindowCompat (core, not the ktx extension) — the plain
                // `window.isAppearanceLightStatusBars` property needs a newer
                // core-ktx than the dependency graph carries.
                WindowCompat.getInsetsController(w, w.decorView)
                    .isAppearanceLightStatusBars = !sheetIsDark
            }
        }
        BoxWithConstraints(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            // W = container width, H = full screen height (MATH CONTRACT inputs).
            val Hpx = constraints.maxHeight.toFloat()
            val Hdp = maxHeight
            val density = LocalDensity.current

            // ── DETENT MATH CONTRACT ─────────────────────────────────────────────
            // HALF = 0.60 × H (sheet height visible at the half detent);
            // FULL = H (top at 0). The sheet's top position is the animated value:
            //   halfTop = H − 0.60·H      (≡ 0.40 × H from the screen top)
            //   fullTop = 0
            // Detent switch threshold: drag > 0.12 × H OR velocity > ~1000dp/s
            // commits the next state, otherwise springs back (Motion.Spatial).
            val halfSheetHeightPx = Hpx * 0.60f            // CONTRACT: HALF = 0.60 × H
            val halfTopPx = Hpx - halfSheetHeightPx        // sheet top at the HALF detent
            val commitDragPx = Hpx * 0.12f                 // CONTRACT: drag > 0.12 × H
            val commitVelocityPx = with(density) { 1000.dp.toPx() }  // CONTRACT: > ~1000dp/s
            val rubberBottomPx = halfTopPx + commitDragPx  // past-half rubber band = one commit distance

            // Single source of truth for the sheet's top edge, animated with
            // Motion.Spatial settings. Gesture paths snapTo() (no animation),
            // release paths animateTo() the winning detent.
            val anim = remember { Animatable(Hpx) }        // enters off-screen, springs to HALF
            val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
            var settleJob by remember { mutableStateOf<Job?>(null) }
            // Distance travelled since the current touch began — the CONTRACT's
            // "drag of > 0.12 × H between detents" is measured on this accumulator.
            var dragAccumPx by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
            var nestedAccumPx by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

            /** Cancel any in-flight detent spring and hand-follow by `dy` px. */
            fun rawFollow(dy: Float) {
                settleJob?.cancel()
                dragAccumPx += dy
                val next = (anim.value + dy).coerceIn(0f, Hpx)
                scope.launch { anim.snapTo(next) }
            }

            /** Spring the sheet to `target` (Motion.Spatial default stiffness). */
            fun springTo(target: Float, stiffness: Float = Motion.SpatialStiffnessDefault) {
                settleJob?.cancel()
                settleJob = scope.launch {
                    anim.animateTo(
                        target,
                        spring(dampingRatio = Motion.SpatialDamping, stiffness = stiffness)
                    )
                }
            }

            /** Slide off the bottom of the screen, then hand control back to the caller. */
            fun dismissWithSpring() {
                settleJob?.cancel()
                settleJob = scope.launch {
                    anim.animateTo(
                        Hpx,
                        spring(dampingRatio = Motion.SpatialDamping, stiffness = Motion.SpatialStiffnessFast)
                    )
                    onDismiss()
                }
            }

            /** Nearest of the two detents (FULL = 0, HALF = halfTop). */
            fun nearestDetent(topPx: Float): Float =
                if (abs(topPx) < abs(topPx - halfTopPx)) 0f else halfTopPx

            /**
             * THE DETENT CONTRACT, in one place: a drag of > 0.12 × H between
             * detents or velocity > ~1000dp/s commits the next state, otherwise
             * springs back. Called with (current top, end velocity, accumulated
             * drag since the touch began) from BOTH gesture providers.
             */
            fun commitAfterRelease(currentTop: Float, velocityPx: Float, dragPx: Float) {
                // The release ends the gesture: the 0.12 × H drag rule is measured
                // per gesture, so both accumulators start fresh next time. (Reset
                // up front — the branches below early-return.)
                dragAccumPx = 0f
                nestedAccumPx = 0f
                // Pulled past the HALF detent: the next state below HALF is dismissed.
                // (A hand-drag all the way to the bottom edge lands here too.)
                if (currentTop > halfTopPx + 1f) {
                    if (velocityPx > commitVelocityPx || (currentTop - halfTopPx) > commitDragPx) {
                        dismissWithSpring()
                    } else {
                        springTo(halfTopPx)
                    }
                    return
                }
                val downCommitted = velocityPx > commitVelocityPx || dragPx > commitDragPx
                val upCommitted = velocityPx < -commitVelocityPx || dragPx < -commitDragPx
                when {
                    // At/past HALF and moving down → dismiss; from FULL → collapse.
                    downCommitted && currentTop > halfTopPx - 1f -> dismissWithSpring()
                    downCommitted -> springTo(halfTopPx)
                    upCommitted -> springTo(0f)
                    else -> springTo(nearestDetent(currentTop))
                }
            }

            // Open at the HALF detent (sheet top = 0.40 × H), sliding up from
            // off-screen with the Motion.Spatial spring.
            LaunchedEffect(halfTopPx) {
                if (anim.value >= Hpx - 0.5f) springTo(halfTopPx)
            }

            // Hero/handle drag: the primary gesture path. On release the CONTRACT
            // threshold decides: commit (detent/dismiss) or spring back.
            val sheetDragState = rememberDraggableState { dy -> rawFollow(dy) }

            // ── NESTED-SCROLL CHOREOGRAPHY (episode list ↔ sheet) ────────────────
            // The list scrolls naturally at FULL. Scroll-down while the list is at
            // its scroll-top is handed to the sheet: it collapses toward HALF and
            // keeps rubber-banding past it, so the release can still resolve a
            // full dismiss. Scroll-up while not fully open expands the sheet FIRST
            // and only hands the scroll to the list once it is completely open.
            val listState = rememberLazyListState()
            val scrollConnection = remember {
                object : NestedScrollConnection {
                    override fun onPreScroll(available: Offset, source: NestedScrollSource): Offset {
                        val dy = available.y
                        if (dy < 0f && anim.value > 0f) {  // content pulled up → expand
                            settleJob?.cancel()
                            if (nestedAccumPx > 0f) nestedAccumPx = 0f  // direction flip
                            nestedAccumPx += dy
                            val next = (anim.value + dy).coerceAtLeast(0f)
                            val consumed = next - anim.value
                            scope.launch { anim.snapTo(next) }
                            return Offset(0f, consumed)
                        }
                        return Offset.Zero
                    }

                    override fun onPostScroll(consumed: Offset, available: Offset, source: NestedScrollSource): Offset {
                        val dy = available.y
                        // Only leftovers reach here: at FULL that means the list
                        // hit its scroll-top while scrolling down → collapse.
                        if (dy > 0f && anim.value < Hpx - 1f) {
                            settleJob?.cancel()
                            if (nestedAccumPx < 0f) nestedAccumPx = 0f  // direction flip
                            nestedAccumPx += dy
                            val next = (anim.value + dy).coerceAtMost(rubberBottomPx)
                            val consumedY = next - anim.value
                            scope.launch { anim.snapTo(next) }
                            return Offset(0f, consumedY)
                        }
                        return Offset.Zero
                    }

                    override suspend fun onPreFling(available: Velocity): Velocity {
                        // Sheet away from FULL: the detent contract resolves the
                        // fling; the list does not scroll under a moving sheet.
                        if (anim.value < 1f) return Velocity.Zero
                        commitAfterRelease(anim.value, available.y, nestedAccumPx)
                        return available
                    }

                    override suspend fun onPostFling(consumed: Velocity, available: Velocity): Velocity {
                        // Fully open + leftover downward fling speed = the list was
                        // at its scroll-top → collapse per the velocity rule.
                        if (available.y > commitVelocityPx) {
                            commitAfterRelease(anim.value, available.y, 0f)
                            return available
                        }
                        return Velocity.Zero
                    }
                }
            }

            // Gesture-area constants for the drag surface: the grip zone and the
            // whole compact header (art band + poster/title/close strip) drag.
            fun Modifier.sheetDrag() = this.draggable(
                state = sheetDragState,
                orientation = Orientation.Vertical,
                onDragStarted = { _ -> dragAccumPx = 0f },
                onDragStopped = { velocity -> commitAfterRelease(anim.value, velocity, dragAccumPx) }
            )

            // ── v6 CONTRACT GEOMETRY (dp expressions of the formulas above) ─────
            // Detent phase as a discrete boolean: derivedStateOf reads the sheet
            // top in the snapshot layer and flips twice per detent change — drag
            // frames re-read anim.value only in the offset/layer lambdas below.
            val isFull by remember { derivedStateOf { anim.value <= halfTopPx / 2f } }

            val statusBarDp = with(density) { WindowInsets.statusBars.getBottom(density).toDp() }

            val gutter = 16.dp                                           // grid gutter G = 16
            val gripZoneH = 30.dp                                        // HALF grip zone (sheet-y 0→30)
            // CONTRACT: poster 76×108 (§2.3 geometry: radius 10, 1dp white-10%
            // hairline — was 76×112/12).
            val posterW = 76.dp
            val posterH = 108.dp
            val posterLeft = 20.dp                                       // CONTRACT: left 20
            // title x = 20 + 76 + 14 = 110 (spec header Row: spacedBy 14)
            // artTop: HALF = below the 30dp grip · FULL = the real status-bar inset.
            val artTop = if (isFull) statusBarDp else gripZoneH
            // poster y: +8 under the band top at HALF · +14 under the status bar at FULL.
            val posterTop = artTop + if (isFull) 14.dp else 8.dp
            // close ✕ offset from the poster top: 0 at FULL · −2dp at HALF.
            val closeTopOffset = if (isFull) 0.dp else (-2).dp
            // Art band: grows with the header so EVERY pinned header element
            // (poster, title, synopsis, pills) always sits on the theme-proof
            // dark imagery — in light mode a white sheet would swallow the
            // light header text otherwise. 14dp of band below the poster,
            // then the 48dp fade into the sheet color.
            val artBandH = (posterTop - artTop) + posterH + 14.dp        // was fixed 104dp
            val artFadeH = 48.dp                                         // CONTRACT: bottom 48dp fade
            // List column top: chips row top. HALF mock y=166 · FULL y=176 on
            // a 34dp status bar, but never above the real art band end on
            // deeper cutouts (statusBarDp > 40dp used to overlap by 8–14dp).
            val listTop = maxOf(
                if (isFull) 176.dp else 166.dp,
                artTop + artBandH + 6.dp
            )

            val scrimAlphaMax = 0.32f  // M3 modal default, kept where the spec is silent
            val sheetShape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 24.dp, topEnd = 24.dp)  // mock: 24px top corners

            // ── SCRAPING STAGE (loading contract) ───────────────────────────────
            // The pipeline exposes no discrete stage text, so two honest stages
            // rotate: "Finding episode pages…" → "Unlocking stream locker…" after
            // ~4s (a multi-hop locker scrape outlasts a spinner's usefulness).
            var lateStage by remember(show.url) { mutableStateOf(false) }
            LaunchedEffect(isLoading, show.url) {
                lateStage = false
                if (isLoading) {
                    delay(4000)
                    lateStage = true
                }
            }
            val stageText = if (lateStage) STAGE_UNLOCKING else STAGE_FINDING

            // "X GB" total over the selection (null when the source reports no
            // sizes — the pill/footer then show the count alone, nothing invented).
            val selectedSizeLabel = sumSelectedSizeLabel(selectedEpisodes)

            // Scrims: M3-black 32% behind everything, alpha derived from the sheet
            // position (read in the DRAW phase — dragging costs no recomposition).
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .drawBehind {
                        val a = (scrimAlphaMax * (1f - (anim.value / Hpx))).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                        drawRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = a))
                    }
                    .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onTap = { onDismiss() }) }
            )

            // ═════════ THE SHEET — one full-H surface translated between detents ═════════
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(Hdp)
                    // Lambda offset: the detent position is applied in the
                    // placement phase; drag frames do not recompose the content.
                    .offset { IntOffset(0, anim.value.roundToInt()) }
                    .clip(sheetShape)
                    .background(pal.bg)
                    // An empty sheet region (below the sticky bar, etc.) must not
                    // let taps fall through to the scrim — only the scrim itself
                    // dismisses. Children (clickables, the list) still win first.
                    .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onTap = { }) }
            ) {
                // ── ART BAND: self-contained dark hero marquee flush to sheet top corners ──
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .sheetDrag()
                        .offset(y = artTop)
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(artBandH)
                        .clip(sheetShape)
                ) {
                    // Obsidian gradient base (was navy-slate #3A4254→#1B2029;
                    // the band is theme-independent dark imagery, so it now
                    // matches the OLED palette's bandStart→bandEnd).
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(
                                Brush.verticalGradient(
                                    listOf(Color(0xFF1C1C24), Color(0xFF0B0B0E))
                                )
                            )
                    )
                    // Data-driven fill with cached poster. Cache-only: the
                    // visible 76x108 poster performs the single network
                    // request; this blurred band must never re-request the
                    // same URL (it simply stays on the gradient when cold).
                    if (show.posterUrl.isNotBlank()) {
                        val backdropReq = PosterRequests.request(
                            context = LocalContext.current,
                            url = show.posterUrl,
                            widthPx = 360,
                            heightPx = 360,
                            fallbackUrl = PosterStore.lastGoodFor(show),
                            networkAllowed = false
                        )
                        SubcomposeAsyncImage(
                            model = backdropReq,
                            contentDescription = null,
                            contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxSize()
                                .blur(24.dp),
                            loading = {},
                            error = {}
                        )
                    }
                    // Rich dark scrim across entire height (preserves dark marquee in both Light and Dark mode)
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(
                                Brush.verticalGradient(
                                    listOf(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.45f), Color(0xEB0B0B0E))
                                )
                            )
                    )
                }

                // ── GRIP ZONE (HALF, sheet-y 0→30): 36×4 drag-handle pill overlaid in banner ──
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .align(Alignment.TopCenter)
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(gripZoneH)
                        .graphicsLayer {
                            alpha = (anim.value / halfTopPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                        }
