        Text(
            value,
            color = pal.textSub,
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
        )
    }
}

// Row-subtitle derivation (presentation only — the facts already riding on the
// title / locker file name, in the approved contract form):
//   qualityInText → "1080p" out of a title or file name
//   codecInText   → "x265" / "hevc" / "h.264" / "av1" out of a file name
// Both normalize lowercase; neither ever invents a value that wasn't there.
private val qualityInText = Regex("""\b(\d{3,4}p)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
private val codecInText = Regex("""x26[45]|hevc|h\.?264|av1""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)

/** Parse (host, file name) from a locker URL without touching the network.
 *  The name comes from the last path segment; query strings (tokens, ?pt=,
 *  &e=…) are never part of the name. */
private fun lockerPreview(url: String): Pair<String, String> {
    val host = try {
        java.net.URI(url.substringBefore('#')).host ?: "—"
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        url.substringAfter("://").substringBefore('/').substringBefore(':').ifBlank { "—" }
    }
    val seg = url.substringBefore('?').substringBefore('#').substringAfterLast('/')
    val name = try {
        java.net.URLDecoder.decode(seg, "UTF-8")
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        seg
    }
    return host to name
}

/** Parse "2.8 GB" / "412 MB" style site-reported sizes into bytes. Null when
 *  the text carries no recognizable size. Deliberately Regex-free — no new
 *  patterns for the generated RegexCompatCatalog to chase. */
private fun sizeTextToBytes(text: String): Double? {
    val t = text.trim().uppercase()
    var i = 0
    while (i < t.length && (t[i].isDigit() || t[i] == '.' || t[i] == ',')) i++
    if (i == 0) return null
    val num = t.substring(0, i).replace(',', '.').toDoubleOrNull() ?: return null
    val unit = t.substring(i).trim()
    return when {
        unit.startsWith("GIB") || unit.startsWith("GB") -> num * 1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0
        unit.startsWith("MIB") || unit.startsWith("MB") -> num * 1024.0 * 1024.0
        unit.startsWith("KIB") || unit.startsWith("KB") -> num * 1024.0
        else -> null
    }
}

/** "4.2 GB" / "316 MB" total over the selected episodes (distinct URLs only —
 *  shared locker anchors must not double-count). Null when the source reports
 *  no sizes at all: the pill and footer then show the count alone. */
private fun sumSelectedSizeLabel(eps: List<EpisodeItem>): String? {
    var bytes = 0.0
    var any = false
    for (ep in eps.distinctBy { it.url }) {
        sizeTextToBytes(ep.sizeText)?.let {
            bytes += it
            any = true
        }
    }
    if (!any) return null
    val mb = bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0)
    return if (mb >= 1024.0) {
        java.lang.String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.1f GB", mb / 1024.0)
    } else {
        java.lang.String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.0f MB", mb)
    }
}

// ── PINNED DUAL PALETTE (drawer contract, theme-proof) ──────────────────────
// Doctrine kept: the drawer NEVER resolves colors through app theme tokens
// mid-layout — it resolves ONE pinned SheetPalette per composition (dark or
// light, chosen once from AnonTheme.colors.isDark). §1's obsidian values are
// the dark instance; light carries the spec's clean light set. Hexes mirror
// the overhaul mockup exactly.
data class SheetPalette(
    val bg: Color,            // sheet background (spec surface: 0xFF0B0B0E / 0xFFFFFFFF)
    val sunk: Color,          // sticky footer / preview chips / queue wells
    val card: Color,          // chips + range field wells (spec surfaceVariant family)
    val group: Color,         // grouped episode inset container (spec surfaceVariant)
    val skeleton: Color,      // skeleton + progress track base
    val skeletonHighlight: Color,
    val hairline: Color,      // 7% white / 8% black — never a bright opaque gray
    val textPrimary: Color,   // 0xFFF4F4F6 / 0xFF0F1115 (spec onSurface)
    val textSub: Color,       // 0xFF8E8E99 / 0xFF5C606B (spec onSurfaceVariant)
    val textMuted: Color,
    val chipInk: Color,       // ink on white/ink selected-chip fills
    val accent: Color,        // progress/accent bars + initials
    val rust: Color,          // failure headline + RETRY text
    val rustAccent: Color,    // RETRY pill fill (14% alpha at use site)
    val rustBorder: Color,
    val emeraldText: Color,   // §2.6 "✓ Downloaded" pill text
    val emeraldTint: Color,   // §2.6 "✓ Downloaded" pill background
    val handle: Color         // drag-handle pill (theme-contrast on sheet bg)
)

private val DarkSheetPalette = SheetPalette(
    bg = Color(0xFF0B0B0E),
    sunk = Color(0xFF141419),
    card = Color(0xFF141419),
    group = Color(0xFF141419),
    skeleton = Color(0xFF22222A),
    skeletonHighlight = Color(0xFF2E2E38),
    hairline = Color(0x12FFFFFF),
    textPrimary = Color(0xFFF4F4F6),
    textSub = Color(0xFF8E8E99),
    textMuted = Color(0xFF84848E),
    chipInk = Color(0xFF0B0B0E),
    accent = Color(0xFF4FB3D9),
    rust = Color(0xFFE4908A),
    rustAccent = Color(0xFFC25B52),
    rustBorder = Color(0x80C25B52),
    emeraldText = Color(0xFF10B981),
    emeraldTint = Color(0x1F10B981),
    handle = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.32f)
)

private val LightSheetPalette = SheetPalette(
    bg = Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
    sunk = Color(0xFFE9ECEF),
    card = Color(0xFFF1F3F5),
    group = Color(0xFFF1F3F5),
    skeleton = Color(0xFFE2E6EA),
    skeletonHighlight = Color(0xFFF0F2F4),
    hairline = Color(0x14000000),
    textPrimary = Color(0xFF0F1115),
    textSub = Color(0xFF5C606B),
    textMuted = Color(0xFF686D79),
    chipInk = Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
    accent = Color(0xFF0E7490),
    rust = Color(0xFFB03E36),
    rustAccent = Color(0xFFC25B52),
    rustBorder = Color(0x80C25B52),
    emeraldText = Color(0xFF059669),
    emeraldTint = Color(0x1F059669),
    handle = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.28f)
)

/** One palette per composition — the sheet never mixes dark and light roles. */
private fun sheetPalette(isDark: Boolean): SheetPalette =
    if (isDark) DarkSheetPalette else LightSheetPalette

// Over-band constants: the art band is theme-independent dark IMAGERY, so the
// header's poster well / hairlines keep the dark values in BOTH themes —
// light-theme text on the dark band must stay light.
private val BandHairline = Color(0x12FFFFFF)
private val BandPosterWell = Color(0xFF1E1E26)   // §1.4 fallback-art well

/** §2.5 grouped-inset row shape: first row rounds its top corners, last row
 *  its bottom — interior rows stay square so the block reads as ONE surface
 *  (the old separate floating cards are gone). */
private fun groupedRowShape(index: Int, count: Int, radius: Dp = 14.dp): Shape {
    if (count <= 1) return RoundedCornerShape(radius)
    val top = if (index == 0) radius else 0.dp
    val bottom = if (index == count - 1) radius else 0.dp
    return RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = top, topEnd = top, bottomStart = bottom, bottomEnd = bottom
    )
}

// ── §4.4 episode-sheet TTL cache (in-memory, 30 minutes) ─────────────────────
// Keyed by `source + showUrl`; stores the last SUCCESSFUL scrape so reopening
// a sheet paints instantly instead of re-crawling for 7-8s. The MainViewModel
// stays untouched (strictly off-limits): this is a presentation-layer cache
// the drawer itself populates from the state it already receives. Nothing
// persists to disk — a process kill simply restores the old re-scrape path.
private data class CachedEpisodeList(
    val episodes: List<EpisodeItem>,
    val synopsis: String,
    val savedAtMs: Long
)

private const val EPISODE_CACHE_TTL_MS = 30L * 60L * 1000L   // §4.4: 30-minute TTL
private const val MAX_CACHED_EPISODE_LISTS = 64
private val cachedEpisodeLists = ConcurrentHashMap<String, CachedEpisodeList>()

private fun putCachedEpisodeList(key: String, item: CachedEpisodeList) {
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    cachedEpisodeLists.entries.removeIf { now - it.value.savedAtMs > EPISODE_CACHE_TTL_MS }
    if (cachedEpisodeLists.size >= MAX_CACHED_EPISODE_LISTS) {
        val oldest = cachedEpisodeLists.entries
            .sortedBy { it.value.savedAtMs }
            .take((cachedEpisodeLists.size - MAX_CACHED_EPISODE_LISTS + 1).coerceAtLeast(1))
        for (e in oldest) {
            cachedEpisodeLists.remove(e.key)
        }
    }
    cachedEpisodeLists[key] = item
}

fun clearCachedEpisodeLists() {
    cachedEpisodeLists.clear()
}

private const val STAGE_FINDING = "Step 1/2 · Finding episode pages…"
private const val STAGE_UNLOCKING = "Step 2/2 · Unlocking stream links…"

    // API 26-29 path: WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is a normal runtime permission.
    // API 30+ has no runtime dialog — "All files access" is Settings-only,
    // handled below with a toast directing the user there.
    private val writeStoragePermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()
    ) { granted ->
        if (granted) {
            // The sheet is still open and its Download guard just refused —
            // without this hint the user had to guess they may tap again.
            Toast.makeText(this, "Storage permission granted — tap Download again", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Storage permission required to download", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    // API 30+ has no runtime dialog; deep-link into the exact Settings page
    // (the toast alone said "enable it in Settings" and left the walking to
    // the user — and the result code is meaningless here, so re-check on
    // return and tell them to tap Download again).
    private val manageStorageLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()
    ) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R && Environment.isExternalStorageManager()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Storage access granted — tap Download again", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    // Gate every download on storage access. Without it the engine guard
    // rejects the write with a confusing IO error (tester report): on
    // API 30+ "All files access" must be enabled in Settings; on API 26-29
    // a normal permission prompt is raised.
    private fun ensureStoragePermission(): Boolean {
        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            if (Environment.isExternalStorageManager()) {
                true
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Enable 'All files access' for Anonrode in Settings",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show()
                try {
                    manageStorageLauncher.launch(
                        Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION).apply {
                            data = android.net.Uri.parse("package:$packageName")
                        }
                    )
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    // Some OEMs drop the All-files-access action — fall back
                    // to the app's own info page (same as MainActivity).
                    try {
                        startActivity(
                            Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).apply {
                                data = android.net.Uri.parse("package:$packageName")
                            }
                        )
                    } catch (_: Exception) {}
                }
                false
            }
        } else {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                true
            } else {
                writeStoragePermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE)
                false
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

            finish()
            return
        }

        val parsed = UrlRouter.parse(sharedText)
        // A share with NO URL in it (a caption, a lyric, a title) parses to a
        // SearchQuery. The download paths cannot handle a query: the sheet
        // used to show the text as a monospace "URL preview" with a live
        // Download button, and the engine would enqueue the prose as a URL —
        // a doomed task with confusing failures after retries.
        if (parsed is ParsedUrl.SearchQuery) {

                this,
                "Shared text contains no link — copy the URL (starting with http) and share again",
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show()
            finish()
            return
        }

        val isInstant = prefs.getBoolean("pref_instant_social", false)

            finish()
            return
        }

        val themeMode = prefs.getString("pref_theme_mode", "dark") ?: "dark"

                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                        .clickable(
                            interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                            indication = null
                        ) { finish() },

                    // width — a centered floating card crammed every control into
                    // a phone-width dialog and felt tight (user-reported).
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter
                ) {
                    QuickShareCard(
                        parsedUrl = parsed,
                        rawUrl = sharedText,
                        defaultQuality = (application as? AnonApp)?.engine?.defaultQuality ?: "720p",
                        onDismiss = { finish() },
                        onDownload = { quality, audioOnly, makeInstant, engineOverride ->

                            } else {

                                    // sets the field in one step). The direct
                                    // prefs.edit() + field poke that used to live
                                    // here was a second, racing write path — the
                                    // dual-path asymmetry the Settings snapshot

                                    appEngine?.setInstantSocial(true)
                                } else if (appEngine != null && appEngine.instantSocialDownload) {

                                    appEngine.setInstantSocial(false)

                                dispatchDownload(parsed, sharedText, quality, audioOnly, engineOverride)

                                finish()

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        // singleInstance: a second share arrives here with the fresh intent.
        // Re-run the whole flow so the sheet shows the new link instead of
        // silently displaying the stale first-share content.
        setIntent(intent)
        recreate()
    }

    private fun extractSharedUrl(intent: Intent?): String {
        if (intent == null) return ""
        val text = intent.getStringExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT)
            ?: intent.clipData?.let { if (it.itemCount > 0) it.getItemAt(0).text else null }?.toString()
            ?: intent.dataString
            ?: ""

        // Extract first HTTP/HTTPS URL from text (e.g. from Instagram captions)
        val matcher = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("""https?://[^\s"'<>]+""").matcher(text)
        return if (matcher.find()) matcher.group(0) else text.trim()
    }

    private fun handleInstantDownload(parsed: ParsedUrl, rawUrl: String) {
        if (!ensureStoragePermission()) return
        if (parsed is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl && com.anonrode.downloader.pipeline.PlaylistPicker.isYoutubePlaylist(parsed.cleanUrl)) {
            val intent = Intent(this, com.anonrode.downloader.MainActivity::class.java).apply {
                action = Intent.ACTION_VIEW
                data = android.net.Uri.parse(parsed.cleanUrl)
                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP
            }
            startActivity(intent)
            Toast.makeText(this, "Opening playlist in app...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        // Honor the user's configured default quality instead of a hardcoded
        // 720p — the in-app SocialModal already seeds from defaultQuality.
        val q = (application as? AnonApp)?.engine?.defaultQuality ?: "720p"
        dispatchDownload(parsed, rawUrl, quality = q, audioOnly = false)
        // User directive 2026-10-15 — presentation never paints the drama site
        // name; "Drama" says what the download is while the site word stays in
        // the model + journal. Social platforms keep their platform label.
        val label = when (parsed) {
            is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl -> parsed.platform
            is ParsedUrl.DramaUrl -> "Drama"
            else -> "Media"
        }
        Toast.makeText(this, "$label download started in background", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun dispatchDownload(parsed: ParsedUrl, rawUrl: String, quality: String, audioOnly: Boolean, engineOverride: String = "auto") {
        if (parsed is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl && com.anonrode.downloader.pipeline.PlaylistPicker.isYoutubePlaylist(parsed.cleanUrl)) {
            val intent = Intent(this, com.anonrode.downloader.MainActivity::class.java).apply {
                action = Intent.ACTION_VIEW
                data = android.net.Uri.parse(parsed.cleanUrl)
                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP
            }
            startActivity(intent)
            Toast.makeText(this, "Opening playlist in app...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val app = application as? AnonApp ?: return
        val engine = app.engine
        val backend = if (engineOverride != "auto") engineOverride else when (parsed) {
            is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl -> "yt-dlp"
            is ParsedUrl.MagnetUrl -> "aria2c"
            is ParsedUrl.DirectMediaUrl -> "aria2c"
            is ParsedUrl.DramaUrl -> "aria2c"
            else -> "yt-dlp"
        }

        when (parsed) {
            is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl -> {
                engine.enqueue(
                    showTitle = "Social/${parsed.platform}",
                    episodeNum = 1,
                    episodeTitle = "${parsed.platform} Video",
                    sourceUrl = parsed.cleanUrl,
                    isDirect = false,
                    backend = backend,
                    parallelSockets = engine.parallelSocketsPerFile,
                    audioOnly = audioOnly,
                    quality = if (audioOnly) null else quality
                )
            }
            is ParsedUrl.MagnetUrl -> {
                engine.enqueue(
                    showTitle = "Torrents",
                    episodeNum = 1,
                    episodeTitle = parsed.title,
                    sourceUrl = parsed.magnet,
                    isDirect = true,
                    backend = backend,
                    parallelSockets = engine.parallelSocketsPerFile
                )
            }
            is ParsedUrl.DirectMediaUrl -> {
                engine.enqueue(
                    showTitle = "Direct Downloads",
                    episodeNum = 1,
                    episodeTitle = parsed.filename,
                    sourceUrl = parsed.url,
                    isDirect = true,
                    backend = backend,
                    parallelSockets = engine.parallelSocketsPerFile
                )
            }
            is ParsedUrl.DramaUrl -> {
                engine.enqueue(
                    showTitle = com.anonrode.downloader.util.NameSanitizer.cleanShowFolder(parsed.showCard.title),
                    episodeNum = 1,
                    episodeTitle = parsed.showCard.title,
                    sourceUrl = parsed.showCard.url,
                    isDirect = false,
                    backend = backend,
                    parallelSockets = engine.parallelSocketsPerFile,
                    quality = if (audioOnly) null else quality,
                    site = parsed.site
                )
            }
            else -> {
                engine.enqueue(
                    showTitle = "Shared Media",
                    episodeNum = 1,
                    episodeTitle = "Shared Media",
                    sourceUrl = rawUrl,
                    isDirect = false,
                    backend = backend,
                    parallelSockets = engine.parallelSocketsPerFile,
                    audioOnly = audioOnly,
                    quality = if (audioOnly) null else quality
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * The share sheet.
 *
 * One decision per glance, per the canonical monochrome system: WHO is
 * downloading (identity header), WHAT is being downloaded (media card with
 * poster/title/source), and HOW (three uniform segment bars + the instant
 * switch), closed by ONE confident primary action. The old sheet stacked six
 * differently-styled control groups with violet-tinted fills — every group
 * competing; the redesign speaks the same selection language everywhere
 * (selected cell = AccentPrimary fill + BackgroundDark ink, everywhere).
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@Composable
fun QuickShareCard(
    parsedUrl: ParsedUrl,
    rawUrl: String,
    // Seeded from the engine (see call site): the in-app SocialModal already
    // respects the configured default — a hardcoded 720p here made the same
    // feature offer two different qualities from two entry points.
    defaultQuality: String = "720p",
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onDownload: (quality: String, audioOnly: Boolean, makeInstant: Boolean, engineOverride: String) -> Boolean
) {
    var audioOnly by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var selectedQuality by remember { mutableStateOf(defaultQuality) }
    var alwaysInstant by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var engineOverride by remember { mutableStateOf("auto") }
    // Guards against double-tap re-enqueue during the dismissal animation.
    var enqueued by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    // User directive 2026-10-15 — the drama source site never paints (the show
    // itself is the card's headline + poster below); a neutral kind word takes
    // its place here and as the source-host fallback.
    val platformName = when (parsedUrl) {
        is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl -> parsedUrl.platform
        is ParsedUrl.DramaUrl -> "Drama"
        is ParsedUrl.MagnetUrl -> "Torrent"
        is ParsedUrl.DirectMediaUrl -> "Direct Media"
        else -> "Web"
    }

    // What is being downloaded — the user's own words for it, not the
    // router's. Never fabricated beyond what the share actually carries.
    val mediaTitle = when (parsedUrl) {
        is ParsedUrl.DramaUrl -> parsedUrl.showCard.title
        is ParsedUrl.MagnetUrl -> parsedUrl.title
        is ParsedUrl.DirectMediaUrl -> parsedUrl.filename
        is ParsedUrl.SocialUrl -> "${parsedUrl.platform} video"
        else -> "Shared media"
    }
    val posterUrl = (parsedUrl as? ParsedUrl.DramaUrl)?.showCard?.posterUrl.orEmpty()

    Card(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clickable(
                interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                indication = null
            ) {},
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = Radius.xl, topEnd = Radius.xl),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = SurfaceElevated),
        border = androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke(1.dp, BorderHairline)
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                // Full-screen theme now sizes this card to the real screen
                // height — the content can exceed small screens, so the sheet
                // scrolls internally (the drag handle stays at the top edge).
                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                .padding(horizontal = Spacing.lg)
                .padding(top = Spacing.md, bottom = Spacing.xl)
        ) {
            // Drag handle — signals a bottom sheet, matches Seal's share UI.
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .padding(bottom = Spacing.md)
                    .size(width = 36.dp, height = 4.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(BorderHairline)
                    .align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally)
            )

            // ---- Identity: WHO is about to download ----
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.md)
            ) {
                // The app mark: ink-on-accent square, the one saturated block
                // on the sheet — identity, not decoration.
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(42.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(Radius.md))
                        .background(AccentPrimary),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Rounded.Download,
                        contentDescription = null,
                        tint = BackgroundDark,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                    )
                }
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Anonrode",
                        fontSize = Type.rowTitle.fontSize,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = TextPrimary
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "Shared link · $platformName",
                        fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize,
                        color = TextMuted,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                }
                IconButton(
                    onClick = onDismiss,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(44.dp)
                ) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(32.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(SurfaceCard),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.Default.Close,
                            contentDescription = "Close",
                            tint = TextSecondary,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }

                // type tile. 1dp white-10% outline — images read as objects.
                val thumbShape = RoundedCornerShape(Radius.sm)
                Box(

                                else -> Icons.Rounded.Link

                            contentDescription = null,

                            modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)

                        maxLines = 2,

                    Text(

                        // KIND ("Drama · 720p"), never by the parsed URL's host;
                        // the neutral platformName already covers the fallback
                        // role the old sourceHost derivation tried to play.
                        text = "$platformName · ${if (audioOnly) "Audio (MP3)" else selectedQuality}",
                        fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize,
                        color = TextSecondary,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 2.dp)
                    )
                    Text(

                        // A URL is data, not decoration — the one place mono
                        // is the honest face (and shrink-on-overflow beats
                        // truncating the middle of an artifact).
                        fontSize = Type.micro.fontSize,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                        color = TextMuted,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 2.dp)
                    )

                    label = "Video",
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                SegmentCell(
                    selected = audioOnly,
                    onClick = { audioOnly = true },
                    icon = Icons.Rounded.Audiotrack,
                    label = "Audio",
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))

                    enqueued = true
                    // The storage permission check can block the download
                    // (sheet stays open): only keep the double-tap guard
                    // armed when a task was actually queued, so the user
                    // can retry after granting permission.
                    val queued = onDownload(selectedQuality, audioOnly, alwaysInstant, engineOverride)
                    if (!queued) {
                        enqueued = false
                    } else {
                        hapticView.confirmHaptic()
                    }
                },
                enabled = !enqueued,
                interactionSource = dlSrc,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(52.dp)
                    .pressScale(dlSrc),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(Radius.md),
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = AccentPrimary, contentColor = BackgroundDark)
            ) {
                Icon(Icons.Rounded.Download, null, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(Spacing.sm))
                Text(
                    text = if (audioOnly) "Download audio" else "Download ${selectedQuality}",
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = Type.sectionTitle.fontSize
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Root-level host for OTA announcements (v3.3.0 phase 2; plan §4.2/§4.4).
 *
 * Renders [AnnouncementManager.current] in one of three payload-controlled
 * modes — "dialog" (M3 alert), "sheet" (bottom card over a tap-to-dismiss
 * scrim) or "banner" (top bar) — with an optional action:
 *  - "none"   → the dismiss/action button just closes it;
 *  - "url"    → opens the payload URL in the browser, then closes;
 *  - "update" → closes and promotes the update prompt/gate via
 *               [UpdateManager.evaluate].
 *
 * Eligibility + once-per-id/rev bookkeeping live in [AnnouncementManager]
 * (the shown-marker is persisted at pick time, so nothing here replays it).
 * The banner mode is deliberately non-modal: a full-screen Box exists only
 * for alignment, and touches outside the banner fall through to the app.
 */
@Composable
fun AnnouncementHost() {
    val active by AnnouncementManager.current.collectAsState()

    // Dialog mode is a window of its own (M3 AlertDialog animates itself):
    // routing it through AnimatedContent would keep a ghost dialog window
    // alive through the exit transition, so it keeps the plain path.
    val dialogAnn = active?.takeIf { it.mode.equals("dialog", ignoreCase = true) }
    if (dialogAnn != null) {
        AnnouncementDialog(dialogAnn)
        return
    }

    // Banner/sheet are in-window overlays and ride one Content Swap — fade +
    // directional slide (banner from the top, sheet from the bottom) on the
    // nav tokens; the outgoing card animates away instead of popping.
    AnimatedContent(
        targetState = active,
        transitionSpec = {
            val targetMode = targetState?.mode?.lowercase()
            val initialMode = initialState?.mode?.lowercase()
            if (targetState != null) {
                (fadeIn(tween(Motion.DurationFast)) +
                    slideInVertically(tween(Motion.DurationFast)) { h ->
                        if (targetMode == "sheet") h / 3 else -h / 3
                    }) togetherWith
                    fadeOut(tween(Motion.DurationNavExit))
            } else {
                fadeIn(tween(Motion.DurationNavExit)) togetherWith
                    (fadeOut(tween(Motion.DurationNavExit)) +
                        slideOutVertically(tween(Motion.DurationNavExit)) { h ->
                            if (initialMode == "sheet") h / 3 else -h / 3
                        })
            }
        },
        label = "announcementHost"
    ) { ann ->
        if (ann != null) AnnouncementOverlay(ann)
    }
}

import com.anonrode.downloader.BuildConfig
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.rules.DynamicRulesManager
import com.anonrode.downloader.update.UpdateManager
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.RemoteLogger
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.UpdateChecker
import com.anonrode.downloader.ui.theme.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Root-level update prompt + force gate (v3.3.0 phase 2; plan §4.2/§4.5).
 *
 * Renders ONLY from [UpdateManager.state] (evaluated against the signed
 * payload; every brick-safety rail lives in the manager — a stale or failed
 * evaluation can never produce FORCED):
 *  - AVAILABLE → dismissible soft card ("Later" = snooze for
 *    force.snoozeHours, default 24h);
 *  - FORCED    → non-dismissible dialog (no back / no outside tap) with
 *    "Update now" (in-app download →  SHA-256-verified → installer) and a
 *    release-page fallback. ESCAPE HATCH: long-press the title 5× → a 24h
 *    bypass + an id-only `gate_bypass` telemetry record, so a bad gate can
 *    never truly brick anyone.
 *
 * The gate blocks UI ONLY — the engine keeps downloading underneath. All
 * telemetry is stage/id-only through the existing encrypted sink.
 */
@Composable
fun UpdateGate() {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val state by UpdateManager.state.collectAsState()
    val message by UpdateManager.message.collectAsState()
    val prefs = remember {
        context.getSharedPreferences("downloader_settings", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    }
    // F8 (QA-V3): plain reads each composition — a payload that lands after
    // the first frame (cold start) must be visible without a restart.
    val policy = DynamicRulesManager.getUpdatePolicy()

    var snoozeUntil by remember { mutableStateOf(prefs.getLong("update_snooze_until_ms", 0L)) }
    val snoozeResetTick by UpdateManager.snoozeResetTick.collectAsState()
    LaunchedEffect(snoozeResetTick) {
        if (snoozeResetTick > 0L) {
            snoozeUntil = prefs.getLong("update_snooze_until_ms", 0L)
        }
    }
    var bypassUntil by remember { mutableStateOf(prefs.getLong("update_gate_bypass_ms", 0L)) }
    var busy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var progress by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var longPresses by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }

    // gate_shown: once per transition into a visible state (id-only).
    var lastShown by remember { mutableStateOf<UpdateManager.State?>(null) }
    LaunchedEffect(state) {
        if (state != lastShown) {
            if (state == UpdateManager.State.AVAILABLE || state == UpdateManager.State.FORCED) {
                try {
                    RemoteLogger.report(
                        type = "gate_shown",
                        message = "update gate shown",
                        context = mapOf(
                            "mode" to if (state == UpdateManager.State.FORCED) "hard" else "soft",
                            "version" to BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE,
                            "rev" to DynamicRulesManager.getActiveRev()
                        )
                    )
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                }
            }
            lastShown = state
        }
    }

    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val isForced = state == UpdateManager.State.FORCED
    // QA-V3 F2: force.mode selects PRESENTATION — "hard" is the locked
    // dialog, "soft" (the default) is the dismissible card. Before this
    // fix, every force config rendered the locked dialog while the ops doc
    // promised "soft = dismissible".
    val hardGate = isForced && (policy?.force?.mode?.lowercase() ?: "soft") == "hard"
    val visible = when (state) {
        // The escape hatch suppresses the HARD gate for 24h, then it returns
        // (a nudge, never a brick). A SOFT force behaves like AVAILABLE
        // (snooze-able) per the payload's force.mode semantics.
        UpdateManager.State.FORCED ->
            if (hardGate) now >= bypassUntil else now >= snoozeUntil
        UpdateManager.State.AVAILABLE -> now >= snoozeUntil
        else -> false
    }
    if (!visible) return

    val body = message.ifBlank {
        if (isForced) "This version is no longer supported. Please update to continue."
        else "A new version is available."
    }

    val startDownload: () -> Unit = {
        if (!busy) {
            busy = true
            error = null
            progress = "Starting…"
            scope.launch {
                val file = UpdateManager.downloadApk(context) { downloaded, total ->
                    progress = if (total > 0L) "${downloaded * 100 / total}%"
                    else "${downloaded / 1_048_576} MB"
                }
                if (file != null) {
                    val launched = UpdateManager.installApk(context, file)
                    if (!launched) error = "Couldn't open the installer — use the release page."
                } else {
                    error = "Download failed or the file didn't verify — use the release page."
                }
                busy = false
            }
        }
    }
    val escape: () -> Unit = {
        bypassUntil = now + 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000
        prefs.edit().putLong("update_gate_bypass_ms", bypassUntil).apply()
        try {
            RemoteLogger.report(
                type = "gate_bypass",
                message = "user bypassed the update gate",
                context = mapOf(
                    "version" to BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE,
                    "rev" to DynamicRulesManager.getActiveRev()
                )
            )
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }
    val snooze: () -> Unit = {
        val hours = policy?.force?.snoozeHours?.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 24
        snoozeUntil = now + hours * 60L * 60 * 1000
        prefs.edit().putLong("update_snooze_until_ms", snoozeUntil).apply()
    }

    if (hardGate) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { /* hard gate: outside/back dismiss disabled */ },
            properties = DialogProperties(
                dismissOnBackPress = false,
                dismissOnClickOutside = false
            ),
            containerColor = SurfaceCard,
            titleContentColor = TextPrimary,
            textContentColor = TextSecondary,
            title = {
                Text(
                    text = "Update required",
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = Type.itemTitle.fontSize,
                    // Escape hatch: five long-presses arm a 24h bypass.
                    modifier = Modifier.pointerInput(Unit) {
                        detectTapGestures(onLongPress = {
                            longPresses += 1
                            if (longPresses >= 5) escape()
                        })
                    }
                )
            },
            text = {
                Column {
                    Text(body, fontSize = Type.body.fontSize)
                    if (busy || progress.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))
                        Text(
                            text = if (busy) "Downloading… $progress" else progress,
                            color = TextMuted,
                            fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize
                        )
                    }
                    error?.let {
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))
                        Text(it, color = StatusWarning, fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize)
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = startDownload, enabled = !busy) {
                    Text(
                        text = if (busy) "Downloading…" else "Update now",
                        color = AccentPrimary,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { UpdateChecker.openInBrowser(context, UpdateChecker.RELEASES_PAGE) }) {
                    Text("Release page", color = TextSecondary)
                }
            }
        )
    } else {
        // Soft prompt — non-modal bottom card (touches outside pass through).
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(Spacing.md)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(Radius.lg))
                    .background(SurfaceCard)
                    .border(1.dp, BorderHairline, RoundedCornerShape(Radius.lg))
                    .navigationBarsPadding()
                    .padding(Spacing.md)
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = if (isForced) "Update required" else "Update available",
                    color = TextPrimary,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = Type.rowTitle.fontSize
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                Text(text = body, color = TextSecondary, fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize)
                if (busy || progress.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                    Text(
                        text = if (busy) "Downloading… $progress" else progress,
                        color = TextMuted,
                        fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize
                    )
                }
                error?.let {
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                    Text(it, color = StatusWarning, fontSize = Type.caption.fontSize)
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    TextButton(onClick = snooze) {
                        Text("Later", color = TextSecondary, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                    }
                    TextButton(onClick = startDownload, enabled = !busy) {
                        Text(
                            text = if (busy) "Downloading…" else "Update now",
                            color = AccentPrimary,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.anonrode.downloader.update

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageInstaller
import androidx.core.content.FileProvider
import com.anonrode.downloader.AnonApp
import com.anonrode.downloader.BuildConfig
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.net.HttpClient
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.rules.DynamicRulesManager
import com.anonrode.downloader.data.rules.UpdatePolicy
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.DebugLog
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.RemoteLogger
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.UpdateCheckResult
import com.anonrode.downloader.util.UpdateChecker
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import okhttp3.Request
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/**
 * True in-app update flow (workstream B, phase 2; plan §3.3/§3.4 + §4.5
 * brick-safety rails).
 *
 * State comes from the signed OTA payload (`update` section): version code,
 * dual hosting sources (VPS mirror first, GitHub fallback), per-ABI SHA-256
 * pins, message, and the optional force-obsolete gate. Everything here is a
 * no-op while the section is absent — the safe state (plan §2).
 *
 * Honesty rules baked in:
 *  - Downloads verify the SHA-256 pin from the signed payload on EVERY
 *    source attempt; a source serving the wrong bytes is skipped, and an
 *    empty/blank pin fails CLOSED (never installs unverified bytes).
 *  - [State.FORCED] is computed only when the force block is enabled with a
 *    non-zero floor AND the active payload is provably fresh (plan §4.5:
 *    a hard gate must never latch onto stale or unknowable policy). This
 *    manager renders nothing itself — S3's gate consumes [state]/[message]
 *    and owns the escape hatch.
 *  - Telemetry (`update_flow`) carries stage + version codes + source KIND
 *    + failure class ONLY — never URLs, file paths, or payload contents.
 *
 * Staleness source (documented decision, no timestamp getter exists on
 * DynamicRulesManager): the newest of (a) `last_rules_sync` written by
 * AnonApp after each successful sync (consts exposed by AnonApp for this),
 * and (b) the verified-payload cache file mtime (`dynamic_scraper_rules.enc`,
 * written by DynamicRulesManager on every accepted payload — same string as
 * its private CACHE_FILE). Both are local facts; when neither exists the age
 * is unknowable and the hard rail fails safe (no FORCED state).
 */
object UpdateManager {

    enum class State { UNKNOWN, UP_TO_DATE, AVAILABLE, FORCED }

    /** Compose-consumable state (contract: S3 renders; only this object
     *  writes). MutableStateFlow is thread-safe for cross-thread updates. */
    val state: MutableStateFlow<State> = MutableStateFlow(State.UNKNOWN)
    val message: MutableStateFlow<String> = MutableStateFlow("")
    val snoozeResetTick: MutableStateFlow<Long> = MutableStateFlow(0L)

    fun clearSnooze(context: Context) {
        try {
            context.getSharedPreferences("downloader_settings", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .remove("update_snooze_until_ms")
                .apply()
            snoozeResetTick.value = System.currentTimeMillis()
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    private const val STALE_RAIL_MS = 14L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000  // plan §4.5 rail 1
    private const val ARTIFACT_DIR = "apk"
    private const val MAX_APK_BYTES = 300L * 1024 * 1024           // sanity cap
    private const val CACHE_FILE_NAME = "dynamic_scraper_rules.enc" // mirror of DynamicRulesManager CACHE_FILE (private there)

    /** "shown" telemetry is once per (state, versionCode) per session — a
     *  recompute storm (every activity resume) must not stream records. */
    private val shownReported = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<String>()

    // ---- evaluation ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Sync, cheap (volatile rules + prefs only). Computes [state]/[message]
     * from the active update policy; safe to call on any thread, never
     * throws. FORCED requires the force block enabled, a non-zero
     * minSupportedVersionCode, this build below the floor, a payload whose
     * age is known and < 14 days (§4.5 rail 1 + rail "minSupported 0"), AND a
     * strictly newer build actually published (QA-V2 F1: a gate must always
     * be satisfiable — never demand an update that does not exist).
     */
    fun evaluate(context: Context) {
        try {
            val policy = DynamicRulesManager.getUpdatePolicy()
            if (policy == null) {
                state.value = State.UNKNOWN
                message.value = ""
                return
            }
            val vc = BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE
            val force = policy.force
            val forceFloor = force?.minSupportedVersionCode ?: 0
            val available = policy.latestVersionCode > vc
            val forced = force?.enabled == true &&
                forceFloor > 0 &&
                vc < forceFloor &&
                available &&
                payloadAgeMs(context) < STALE_RAIL_MS
            val newState = when {
                forced -> State.FORCED
                available -> State.AVAILABLE
                else -> State.UP_TO_DATE
            }
            state.value = newState
            message.value = if (newState == State.AVAILABLE || newState == State.FORCED) {
                policy.message.ifBlank { "A new version (${policy.latestVersionName}) is available." }
            } else {
                ""
            }
            if (newState == State.AVAILABLE || newState == State.FORCED) {
                val key = "$newState:${policy.latestVersionCode}"
                if (shownReported.add(key)) {
                    reportFlow(
                        "shown", mapOf(
                            "state" to newState.name,
                            "latest_version" to policy.latestVersionName,
                            "latest_vc" to policy.latestVersionCode,
                            "app_vc" to vc
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            // Evaluation failure = never a gate (rail 1); stay honest.
            state.value = State.UNKNOWN
            message.value = ""
            DebugLog.engine("UpdateManager.evaluate failed: ${t.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
    }

    /** Newest provable "payload is current" timestamp (see class KDoc). */
    private fun payloadAgeMs(context: Context): Long {
        val lastSync = try {
            context.getSharedPreferences(AnonApp.PREFS_SERVERLESS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getLong(AnonApp.KEY_LAST_RULES_SYNC, 0L)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            0L
        }
        val cacheMtime = try {
            File(context.filesDir, CACHE_FILE_NAME).lastModified()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            0L
        }
        val newest = maxOf(lastSync, cacheMtime)
        // 0 = no evidence of any verified payload → unknowable → "infinitely
        // old" so the hard rail fails closed.
        if (newest <= 0L) return Long.MAX_VALUE
        return (System.currentTimeMillis() - newest).coerceAtLeast(0L)
    }

    // ---- download -----------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Walks `policy.sources` IN PAYLOAD ORDER; URL = source.base +
     * per-ABI filename. Each attempt streams to cacheDir/apk/ and must
     * match the payload's SHA-256 pin — a mismatch (or any error) deletes
     * the partial file and moves to the next source. Returns the verified
     * file or null. Never throws.
     */
    suspend fun downloadApk(
        context: Context,
        onProgress: (downloaded: Long, totalBytes: Long) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): File? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val policy = DynamicRulesManager.getUpdatePolicy() ?: return@withContext null
            val artifact = pickArtifact(policy) ?: run {
                reportFlow("failed", mapOf("failure" to "no_artifact_for_abi"))
                return@withContext null
            }
            val expected = normalizeHex(artifact.sha256)
            if (expected == null) {
                // Fail closed: refusing to download bytes we cannot verify.
                reportFlow(
                    "failed",
                    mapOf("failure" to "no_pin", "app_vc" to BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE)
                )
                return@withContext null
            }
            val dir = File(context.cacheDir, ARTIFACT_DIR)
            if (!dir.exists() && !dir.mkdirs()) {
                reportFlow("failed", mapOf("failure" to "cache_dir"))
                return@withContext null
            }
            val out = File(dir, artifact.file)

            reportFlow(
                "downloading",
                mapOf(
                    "latest_version" to policy.latestVersionName,
                    "latest_vc" to policy.latestVersionCode
                )
            )
            var lastFailure = "no_sources"
            for (source in policy.sources) {
                val base = source.base.trim()
                if (!base.startsWith("http://") && !base.startsWith("https://")) continue
                val url = base.trimEnd('/') + "/" + artifact.file
                val failure = tryDownloadTo(url, out, onProgress)
                if (failure != null) {
                    lastFailure = "${failure}:${source.kind}"
                    DebugLog.engine("UpdateManager: source ${source.kind} failed ($failure)")
                    continue
                }
                val actual = sha256File(out)
                if (actual == null || actual != expected) {
                    out.delete()
                    lastFailure = "mismatch:${source.kind}"
                    DebugLog.error("UpdateManager: SHA-256 mismatch from ${source.kind} — refusing")
                    continue
                }
                reportFlow(
                    "verified",
                    mapOf(
                        "latest_vc" to policy.latestVersionCode,
                        "source" to source.kind.ifBlank { "unknown" }
                    )
                )
                return@withContext out
            }
            out.delete()
            reportFlow("failed", mapOf("failure" to lastFailure))
            null
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            reportFlow("failed", mapOf("failure" to (t.javaClass.simpleName)))
            null
        }
    }

    private data class Artifact(val file: String, val sha256: String)

    /** arm64 device → per-ABI file when named; anything else (32-bit ARM,
     *  x86 emulators) → universal. The payload only ships these two. */
    private fun pickArtifact(policy: UpdatePolicy): Artifact? {
        val arm64 = android.os.Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.firstOrNull()?.contains("arm64") == true
        val file = if (arm64) policy.apkArm64 else policy.apkUniversal
        val pin = if (arm64) policy.sha256Arm64 else policy.sha256Universal
        if (file.isBlank()) return null
        return Artifact(file = file, sha256 = pin)
    }

    /** Streams [url] into [out]; returns null on success or a short failure
     *  class on any error (never a URL — telemetry-safe by construction). */
    private fun tryDownloadTo(
        url: String,
        out: File,
        onProgress: (Long, Long) -> Unit
    ): String? {
        val tmp = File(out.parentFile, out.name + ".part")
        var response: okhttp3.Response? = null
        return try {
            val request = Request.Builder()
                .url(url)
                .header("User-Agent", HttpClient.DEFAULT_UA)
                .build()
            response = HttpClient.shared.newCall(request).execute()
            if (!response.isSuccessful) return "http_${response.code}"
            val body = response.body ?: return "empty_body"
            val total = body.contentLength().let { if (it > 0) it else 0L }
            if (total > MAX_APK_BYTES) return "too_large"
            var downloaded = 0L
            body.byteStream().use { input ->
                tmp.outputStream().use { output ->
                    val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
                    while (true) {
                        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) {
                            throw kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException("APK download interrupted/cancelled")
                        }
                        val n = input.read(buf)
                        if (n < 0) break
                        downloaded += n
                        if (downloaded > MAX_APK_BYTES) return "too_large"
                        output.write(buf, 0, n)
                        onProgress(downloaded, total)
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!tmp.renameTo(out)) {
                tmp.delete()
                return "rename_failed"
            }
            null
        } catch (ce: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
            tmp.delete()
            throw ce
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            tmp.delete()
            t.javaClass.simpleName
        } finally {
            try { response?.close() } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }
    }

    private fun sha256File(file: File): String? = try {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().use { input ->
            val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
            while (true) {
                val n = input.read(buf)
                if (n < 0) break
                digest.update(buf, 0, n)
            }
        }
        digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        null
    }

    private fun normalizeHex(raw: String?): String? {
        val hex = raw?.trim()?.lowercase()?.replace(":", "")?.replace(" ", "") ?: return null
        if (hex.length != 64 || hex.any { it !in "0123456789abcdef" }) return null
        return hex
    }

    // ---- install ------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Hands a VERIFIED apk to the system. Primary path: PackageInstaller
     * session (framework API, zero deps; REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES is in the
     * manifest since phase 1); fallback: ACTION_VIEW with a FileProvider URI
     * (the existing `${applicationId}.fileprovider` + file_paths.xml already
     * cover all of cacheDir). Returns true when the system took over the
     * flow — the user still confirms in the installer UI either way.
     */
    fun installApk(context: Context, apk: File): Boolean {
        reportFlow("install_started", mapOf("app_vc" to BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE))
        if (!apk.exists() || apk.length() <= 0L) return false
        val sessionOk = try {
            installViaSession(context, apk)
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            DebugLog.error("UpdateManager: session install failed (${t.javaClass.simpleName}), falling back to ACTION_VIEW")
            false
        }
        if (sessionOk) return true
        return viewFallback(context, apk)
    }

    private fun installViaSession(context: Context, apk: File): Boolean {
        val installer = context.packageManager.packageInstaller
        val params = PackageInstaller.SessionParams(PackageInstaller.SessionParams.MODE_FULL_INSTALL)
        val sessionId = installer.createSession(params)
        installer.openSession(sessionId).use { session ->
            session.openWrite("base.apk", 0, apk.length()).use { output ->
                apk.inputStream().use { input -> input.copyTo(output) }
            }
            val resultIntent = Intent(context, PackageInstallerResultReceiver::class.java)
            val pending = android.app.PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                context,
                sessionId,
                resultIntent,
                android.app.PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or android.app.PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE
            )
            session.commit(pending.intentSender)
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun viewFallback(context: Context, apk: File): Boolean = try {
        val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, context.packageName + ".fileprovider", apk)
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW)
            .setDataAndType(uri, "application/vnd.android.package-archive")
            .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
        context.startActivity(intent)
        true
    } catch (t: Throwable) {
        DebugLog.error("UpdateManager: install intent failed (${t.javaClass.simpleName})")
        false
    }

    // NOTE (QA-V2 F5): the earlier string-returning `checkForUpdate` wrapper
    // was removed as dead code — Settings runs the structured
    // util/UpdateChecker.check() chain itself and then calls [evaluate] so a
    // manual check also refreshes the prompt/gate state. This object stays
    // the single source for [state]/[message].

    // ---- telemetry ----------------------------------------------------------

    /** One `update_flow` record per stage; aggregate, id-only (plan §10). */
    private fun reportFlow(stage: String, extra: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()) {
        try {
            RemoteLogger.report(
                type = "update_flow",
                message = "update flow: $stage",
                context = mapOf("stage" to stage) + extra
            )
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Result hand-off for the PackageInstaller session (manifest-declared,
 * exported="false" — the system delivers the result explicitly). On
 * STATUS_PENDING_USER_ACTION the system wants the confirmation launched;
 * failures are logged as class-only telemetry. Never touches user data.
 */
class PackageInstallerResultReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        try {
            val status = intent.getIntExtra(PackageInstaller.EXTRA_STATUS, PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE)
            when (status) {
                PackageInstaller.STATUS_PENDING_USER_ACTION -> {
                    val confirm = intent.getParcelableExtra(Intent.EXTRA_INTENT) as? Intent ?: return
                    confirm.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                    context.startActivity(confirm)
                }
                PackageInstaller.STATUS_SUCCESS -> {
                    DebugLog.user("UpdateManager: package installer reported success")
                }
                else -> {
                    val cls = when (status) {
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE -> "failure"
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE_ABORTED -> "aborted"
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE_BLOCKED -> "blocked"
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE_CONFLICT -> "conflict"
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE_INCOMPATIBLE -> "incompatible"
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE_INVALID -> "invalid"
                        PackageInstaller.STATUS_FAILURE_STORAGE -> "storage"
                        else -> "unknown_$status"
                    }
                    try {
                        RemoteLogger.report(
                            type = "update_flow",
                            message = "update flow: failed",
                            context = mapOf("stage" to "failed", "failure" to "installer_$cls")
                        )
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }
}

package com.anonrode.downloader.security

import java.io.File
import java.io.RandomAccessFile
import java.net.URLEncoder
import java.util.regex.Pattern

/**
 * 7-Layer Anti-Malware & Torrent Security Shield.
 * Directly ported from monolith `src/security.py`.
 *
 * Layers:
 *   1. Uploader Trust & Reputation (VIP/trusted floor, minimum seeders)
 *   2. Extension & Double-Extension Blacklist
 *   3. InfoHash SHA1 / Base32 Validation
 *   4. Magnet & Shell Metacharacter Sanitizer
 *   5. Negative Filters (CAM/TS, password/archive scams)
 *   6. Scope-Aware Plausible Size Guard (minimums and maximums)
 *   7. Post-Download Magic-Byte Container Inspector & Path Traversal Guard
 */
object TorrentSecurityShield {

    // --- Layer 1: Trust Tiers & Seeder Thresholds ---
    const val TRUST_VIP = "vip"
    const val TRUST_TRUSTED = "trusted"
    const val TRUST_MEMBER = "member"

    private val MIN_SEEDERS = mapOf(

    // --- Layer 2: Blacklisted Extensions ---
    val BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS = setOf(
        ".exe", ".dll", ".lnk", ".bat", ".cmd", ".vbs", ".vbe",
        ".js", ".jse", ".wsf", ".wsh", ".ps1", ".ps2", ".msc",
        ".msi", ".msp", ".scr", ".iso", ".img", ".inf", ".reg",
        ".hta", ".cpl", ".jar", ".com", ".pif", ".application",
        ".gadget", ".appref-ms", ".sct", ".ws", ".mst", ".chm",
        // Android-native executable formats — the single most relevant
        // malware vector for this platform (fake "codec"/"player" APKs).
        ".apk", ".aab", ".so", ".dex"
    )

    // --- Layer 3: InfoHash Regex ---
    private val INFOHASH_HEX = Pattern.compile("^[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$")
    private val INFOHASH_B32 = Pattern.compile("^[A-Z2-7]{32}$")

    // --- Layer 4: Shell & URI Dangerous Characters ---
    private val SHELL_DANGER = Pattern.compile("[;&|`$\\r\\n\\u0000-\\u001f]")
    private val MAGNET_DANGER = Pattern.compile("[;|`$\\r\\n\\u0000-\\u001f]")

    // High-uptime public trackers
    val TRACKERS = listOf(
        "udp://tracker.opentrackr.org:1337/announce",
        "udp://open.stealth.si:80/announce",
        "udp://tracker.torrent.eu.org:451/announce",
        "udp://exodus.desync.com:6969/announce",
        "udp://tracker.openbittorrent.com:6969/announce",
        "udp://opentracker.i2p.rocks:6969/announce",
        "udp://tracker.dler.org:6969/announce",
        "udp://explodie.org:6969/announce",
        "udp://open.demonii.com:1337/announce",
        "udp://tracker.tiny-vps.com:6969/announce"
    )

    // --- Layer 5: Negative Filter Patterns ---
    private val CAM_RE = Pattern.compile("""(?i)(?:CAM|HDTS|TELESYNC|TS[\-\.]?RIP|HDCAM)""")
    private val SUSPICIOUS_CONTENT_RE = Pattern.compile("""(?i)(?:password|passcode|pass\s*in\s*txt)|\.(?:rar|zip|7z)""")
    private val EXECUTABLE_RE = Pattern.compile("""(?i)\.(?:exe|bat|cmd|scr|msi|ps1|vbs|js|com|pif)(?:|$)""")
    private val CAM_INTENT_RE = Pattern.compile("""(?i)cam""")

    private val MAGIC_ZIP_PK = byteArrayOf(0x50.toByte(), 0x4b.toByte())
    private val MAGIC_OGG = "OggS".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
    private val MAGIC_FLAC = "fLaC".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)

    private val MAGIC_ELF = byteArrayOf(0x7f.toByte(), 0x45.toByte(), 0x4c.toByte(), 0x46.toByte()) // "ELF"

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // LAYER 1: Uploader Trust Check
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    fun checkUploaderTrust(status: String, seeders: Int): Pair<Boolean, String> {
        val tier = when (status.lowercase().trim()) {
            "vip" -> TRUST_VIP
            "trusted" -> TRUST_TRUSTED
            else -> TRUST_MEMBER
        }
        val minSeeds = MIN_SEEDERS[tier] ?: MIN_SEEDERS_DEFAULT
        if (seeders < minSeeds) {
            return Pair(false, "Too few seeders ($seeders) for $tier tier (needs $minSeeds+)")
        }
        return Pair(true, tier)
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // LAYER 2: Extension & Double-Extension Shield
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    fun checkExtensions(name: String): Pair<Boolean, String> {
        if (name.isBlank()) return Pair(false, "Empty release name")
        val clean = name.lowercase().trim()
        val segments = clean.split('.')

        // Check double-extension attack first (e.g. Movie.mp4.apk): a blocked
        // extension anywhere in the name — not just the final position — is a
        // hidden-executable disguise and must be reported as such.
        if (segments.size >= 3) {
            for (i in 1 until segments.size) {
                val segExt = "." + segments[i]
                if (segExt in BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS) {
                    return Pair(false, "Hidden executable in name: ...${segments[i - 1]}.${segments[i]}")
                }
            }
        }

        // Check final extension
        if (segments.size > 1) {
            val finalExt = "." + segments.last()
            if (finalExt in BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS) {
                return Pair(false, "Blocked extension: $finalExt")
            }
        }

        val base = segments.firstOrNull() ?: ""
        if (base.length < 2) {
            return Pair(false, "Suspiciously short release name")
        }

        return Pair(true, "")
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // LAYER 3: InfoHash Validation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    fun checkInfoHash(infoHash: String): Pair<Boolean, String> {
        val h = infoHash.trim()
        if (INFOHASH_HEX.matcher(h).matches() || INFOHASH_B32.matcher(h).matches()) {
            return Pair(true, "")
        }
        return Pair(false, "Malformed info_hash: $h")
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // LAYER 4: Magnet URI Construction & Injection Guard
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    fun buildSanitizedMagnet(infoHash: String, name: String): Pair<String?, String> {
        val hashCheck = checkInfoHash(infoHash)

        val cleanName = SHELL_DANGER.matcher(name).replaceAll("").trim().ifEmpty { infoHash }

        }

        return Pair(magnet, "")
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // LAYER 5: Negative Filters (CAM/TS, Password, Archives)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    fun checkNegativeFilters(name: String, userQuery: String = ""): Pair<Boolean, String> {
        if (name.isBlank()) return Pair(true, "")

        if (!CAM_INTENT_RE.matcher(userQuery).find()) {
            if (CAM_RE.matcher(name).find()) {
                return Pair(false, "Excluded low-quality CAM/TS release")
            }
        }

        if (SUSPICIOUS_CONTENT_RE.matcher(name).find()) {
            return Pair(false, "Excluded passworded/archive release")
        }

        if (EXECUTABLE_RE.matcher(name).find()) {
            return Pair(false, "Excluded dangerous executable extension")
        }

        return Pair(true, "")
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------

    fun checkSizePlausible(name: String, sizeBytes: Long): Pair<Boolean, String> {
